entries.text: Revisiting Past Relationships
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Venus stations direct in Pisces – April 12, 2025 (9:02 PM EST)

entries.text: Love doesn’t always end with finality. Some connections fade, not from lack of feeling, but from timing, distance, or the weight of what was left unsaid. Some end because they had to, because the version of you that loved them could not continue as you were. Sometimes, we walk away from something before we fully understand what we’re leaving. And yet, Venus retrograde pulls the past back into the present, placing old loves and lost desires in front of you once again.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Venus stations direct in Pisces – April 12, 2025 (9:02 PM EST)

entries.text: Venus Rx allows for the possibility that something unfinished may still have life in it. If an ex reappears, if you feel pulled toward someone you once knew, this is the time to ask: Is there something here that still deserves exploration? This is not about throwing yourself into old patterns just because they feel familiar. This is about discernment. About seeing what you couldn’t see before. About revisiting past relationships with a clearer sense of who you are now. Questions to ask yourself: Am I reaching for this person because I miss them, or because I miss who I was when I was with them? Has anything truly changed, or am I just longing for comfort? If this person were brand new to me, would I still choose them?

entries.text: Not every ember needs to be reignited. But, if you reconnect with a past partner, wait until Venus stations direct on April 12 before making any permanent decisions. What feels like a "meant to be" moment now may shift when Venus moves forward again.

entries.text: Venus retrograde already pulls at you, while other planetary transits layer over it: Mercury retrograde, two eclipses, and Neptune’s shift into Aries. Every planetary shift during this retrograde is a pressure point, a challenge, a test of whether your past choices still hold, or whether they need to be reconsidered.

entries.text: Venus retrograde rewrites desire; Mercury retrograde scrambles the signal. Both move backward through Aries and Pisces, twisting the past in different ways. Words slip, distort, disappear. A message you’ve been waiting for may never arrive. A conversation you thought was over might restart with no warning. What was once certain is now tangled in hesitation.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Aries ignites impulse. You may send a text before you’ve thought it through. You may say something you can’t take back. Mercury here is impatient, reactive, willing to burn bridges and build them again within the same breath. But when Mercury falls back into Pisces, the tone shifts. Clarity dissolves. Meaning becomes fluid. Someone may reach out, but not know why. Apologies may be spoken, but not hold.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Lunar eclipses are swift, decisive, and unsentimental. They don’t wait for you to be ready. They arrive as severance, as endings that can no longer be delayed. This one, in Virgo, sign of discernment and purification, cuts away what is flawed, what is unsustainable, what no longer holds. It occurs just as Venus reaches the heart of her retrograde, doubling down on the need for reassessment.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Mercury Retrograde in Aries & Pisces (March 15 – April 7, 2025)
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: If you’ve been holding onto something that has already expired, a relationship that’s lost its foundation, a financial decision that no longer supports you, a belief about love or self-worth that keeps you bound, this eclipse will rip off the disguise. Virgo does not deal in fantasy. It does not allow you to keep pretending something works when it doesn’t.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Solar eclipses signal beginnings, initiations, bold leaps forward. But when Venus is retrograde, beginnings don’t always hold. This Aries eclipse charges the atmosphere with urgency, to claim, to chase, to act. The temptation will be to move quickly, to grasp at what is returning, to say yes before you understand the consequences.

entries.text: Aries wants action. But Venus in Pisces is still dissolving, unraveling, undoing. A new opportunity may appear: a relationship, a creative pursuit, a career shift. But is it real, or just the first thing to fill the void? Before you move forward, ask: Am I choosing this because I truly want it? Or because I don’t want to sit with what I’ve lost?

entries.text: This eclipse is a match, a spark, a rush of momentum. But not every fire is meant to be lit. Before you act, make sure it’s not just an escape disguised as an opportunity. What’s real will still be there when the dust settles.

entries.text: Neptune’s entrance into Aries is the end of one era and the ignition of another. After 14 years in Pisces, dissolving boundaries and eroding certainty, making us long for something bigger, more divine, more all-encompassing, Neptune now shifts into Aries, a sign that does not wait for the dream to arrive, it chases it. The collective moves from surrender to pursuit. the timing of this shift is messy. Venus, still deep in her retrograde, has just slipped back into Pisces. The past is not yet done with us. The illusion does not break, it mutates. The fantasy you thought you were finished with may regain its hold. A lost love may start to seem possible again. A dream you left behind may suddenly feel like the only thing that matters. But is it real? Or is it simply the pull of Neptune, reshaping desire, distorting longing, making the past feel like the future?

entries.text: Neptune in Aries calls us to move, to initiate, to claim what we want. But Venus in Pisces is still dissolving, still undoing, still unraveling the truth from the illusion. As Neptune shifts, ask yourself: Is this a dream worth chasing, or just the first thing to appear in the void? As Venus finishes her retrograde and Neptune fully settles into Aries, clarity will come.

entries.text: The past returns to be understood. Old lovers, former friends, unresolved connections, they surface to be mirrors. And, not everything that knocks on your door is meant to be let back in.

Investments demand reevaluation. The way you spend, save, and assign value, both to currency and to yourself is no longer automatic. Pay attention.

entries.text: How to Work with Venus Retrograde
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The past does not return as an invitation. It returns as a test. What have you learned? What are you still gripping with both hands? What must be burned to the ground?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: 1. Don’t Rekindle Old Flames Without a Reality Check. If someone from your past resurfaces, observe rather than act. Nostalgia is not truth. Time will reveal what needs no further explanation. No sudden moves. No declarations. Let the story unfold before you decide if you still belong in it. Venus stations direct on April 12. Until then, nothing is certain.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: 2. Take Inventory of Your Self-Worth. Retrogrades pull energy inward, forcing an inventory of what we’ve ignored. Where have you undervalued yourself? In love, in work, in the quiet spaces where no one is watching? Venus does not reward what is unclaimed. If you want more, decide you are worth it first.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: 3. Hold Off on Major Beauty Changes. Venus rules adornment. Expression. The way you shape yourself to be seen. But during retrograde, vision is skewed. The hair dye, the tattoo, the wardrobe overhaul. What feels like reinvention now may feel like regret later. When do you feel most like yourself? When do you feel most real? Let that guide you forward, rather than the impulse to disappear and emerge as someone new.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: 4. Be Mindful with Money & Investments. Venus governs wealth and material security. Under retrograde, currency moves differently. What once felt stable may shift. What seemed impossible may return. Wait before making major financial commitments. Purchases made now may not hold their value. Investments may not be what they seem. Venus retrograde reveals financial blind spots.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: 5. Release Old Fantasies. Pisces dissolves illusions. The dreams you were once chasing, do they still belong to you? The love you swore would last forever, was it ever real, or just a story you needed at the time?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: 6. Revisit, Don’t Launch. Venus retrograde resurrects old inspiration. A forgotten creative project calls to you, a once-abandoned pursuit flickers back to life. This is not the time to start something new. Instead, return to what was left undone. Reread your old drafts. Dust off your unfinished paintings. Pick up the instrument, the brush, the poem that once felt like a lifeline. There is gold buried in the past, but it must be refined before it sees the light.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under How This Can Unfold

entries.text: 7. Look Back to 2017 & 2009 for patterns. Venus last retrograded through Aries-Pisces in March–April 2017 and March–April 2009. What was happening in your love life then? Your finances? Your sense of self-worth? What was unraveling? What was just beginning? If the same themes are resurfacing now, this is not a coincidence. This is a cycle repeating itself, offering you another choice.

entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Venus stations retrograde in your 1st house of identity, selfhood, and autonomy, dragging you back through the versions of yourself you once were in love, in ambition, in pursuit. You may feel the urge to change something - your hair, your name, the way you walk into a room. But this is not the moment for reinvention. This is a moment of recognition. What parts of yourself did you discard in past relationships? What desires have you twisted to fit someone else’s mold? If a former lover returns, ask yourself if you want them, or just the person you were with them.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Then, on April 3, Venus re-enters Pisces, slipping into your 12th house of hidden truths, endings, and the subconscious. Here, the fire burns out. Old grief resurfaces. The ghosts of past loves come to haunt you. A sacrifice you made in the name of love, a loss you never fully grieved, a dream you left behind, they all come rushing in. By April 12, the question will no longer be who do I want? but who am I without them?

entries.text: Venus, your ruling planet, disappears into the underworld of your chart, where old dreams, unspoken words, and unfinished stories surface. At first, this is subtle. A name you haven’t thought of in years reappears. A feeling you buried creeps in through a song, a dream, a photo. But the further Venus moves back, the less avoidable it becomes. If you’ve been carrying an old heartbreak, it will find its way into your present. When Venus re-enters Aries, the illusions end. What was once hidden becomes obvious. If you abandoned a vision, if you lost a friendship to time or distance, this is when they return. The past doesn’t stay buried, and old lovers, betrayals, or self-sabotaging behaviors re-emerge to be understood. Who have you been in your relationships? What have you settled for in the name of comfort? As Venus stations direct, you will be left with a choice: to continue carrying what weighs you down, or to finally fix mistakes from the past.

entries.text: What happens when the people you thought you left behind find their way back to you? Venus begins its descent in the sector of friendships and collaborations, bringing back old connections, past creative partnerships, and long-forgotten goals. This is about your legacy, the alliances you’ve built, and the future you’ve been working toward. A friend from another lifetime reappears, or perhaps an unfinished project resurfaces. When Venus slips back into Pisces, your career and public life take the hit. Did you pursue something for the sake of validation rather than true fulfillment? A professional opportunity from the past may return. Do you want it, or do you just want to prove you could have had it? The image you’ve projected may need to shift. By the time Venus moves forward again, your direction clears, but only if you’ve been willing to sit with the discomfort.

entries.text: Venus retrograde moves through your career and public image, forcing you to examine the structures you’ve built your ambitions upon. An old opportunity may return, or a path you abandoned might call you back. There’s a need to reassess why you wanted what you wanted in the first place. Was it for status? Power? Security? Recognition? Or did you mistake someone else’s measure of success for your own? This retrograde unearths the truth about what drives you. If you’ve been seeking validation through achievement, Aries will make the hunger unbearable. If you’ve been holding onto a career identity that no longer fits, Aries will set it on fire. When Venus moves into Pisces, your beliefs shift. The tower collapses. A philosophy you once stood by no longer holds. A mentor from the past may reappear, or an old plan to return to school, travel, or write may find its way back to you. By April 12, the illusion will have lifted. What once felt like an impossible question will answer itself. Whether you reclaim an old dream or abandon it for good, you will know what was real and what was just another ladder leading nowhere.

entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Venus retrograde forces you to face your own illusions about love, risk, and the future. You may find yourself drawn back to a person, an idea, or a version of yourself that once felt limitless. You have a tendency to romanticize the past. To look back and see only the gold. But Venus in Aries isn’t sentimental. A romance from the past may resurface, or a creative endeavor you once abandoned may return for a second chance. Venus in Aries demands honesty, and by the time it retrogrades into Pisces, the fantasy gives way to reality. Pisces pulls you into the depths of emotional and financial entanglements. Old debts, both literal and metaphorical, come due. What have you borrowed from others? What have you given away without question? If a past relationship resurfaces, so does the cost of what you gave to it. What did you trade away for connection? What part of yourself got smaller to make room for someone else? There’s no sidestepping the truth here. By April 12, you’ll know what’s worth investing in and what has already run its course.

entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Venus retrograde drags you through the territory of work, daily routines, health, and relationships before pulling you deeper into intimacy, shared resources, and deep emotional ties. At first, this retrograde looks like a simple reassessment of how you manage your responsibilities, but as Venus continues her retrograde, it becomes clear that what’s really at stake is who you allow into your most vulnerable spaces and what you’ve given away without realizing it. If you've given too much—emotionally, financially, or energetically. This retrograde makes it obvious. You may find yourself revisiting past relationships that left you feeling drained, old investments that didn’t pay off, or debts that need to be settled. This is about the energetic exchanges that have shaped your life. By April 3, Venus backs into your 7th house of relationships, making it clear that the dynamics playing out in your personal connections are directly tied to deeper issues of power and worth. A past partner may reappear, not necessarily to rekindle, but to remind you of what you accepted and why. Are you the one who always compromises, always bends? If you’ve been involved in a business or romantic partnership that has felt unbalanced, this retrograde forces you to confront the reality of that dynamic. By April 12, the illusions lift. You will know what relationships deserve your energy and where you need to draw the line. The question is no longer "What do I owe this person?" but "What do I owe myself?"

entries.text: Venus retrograde is a stripping away. A confrontation with the patterns that shape your relationships. The silent agreements, the quiet compromises, the ways you’ve bent to keep the peace without asking what it’s cost you. If something ended without closure, expect the door to open. The question isn’t just who is coming back? but why? Have you softened yourself to be more acceptable, more digestible, more easy to love? Some relationships will reveal their expiration dates. Others will show you where the real work begins. By April 3, Venus moves back into your 6th house of work, health, the daily rhythms that make up your life. This is where the consequences of your relationships become physical. The exhaustion that won’t fade. The stress that lingers in your body. The way you structure your day around someone else’s needs instead of your own. If something has been quietly draining you, this is when it makes itself known. By April 12, the choice will be clear: keep stretching yourself thin for the sake of balance, or step back into alignment with what actually sustains you.

entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Venus retrograde is an edit. A refinement. A pause to strip away what isn’t working. It starts in your 6th house of work, health, the rhythms of daily life. The systems you rely on. The habits that hold you together, or don’t. A slowdown forces you to notice what you’ve been missing. Maybe it’s your body. Maybe it’s your energy. Maybe it’s the way your work has become a cycle of output with no inspiration left inside it. If you’ve been running on fumes, this is when you crash. A past project, a past job resurfaces. Not everything needs to be reclaimed, but it does need to be thought through. Then, on April 3, Venus moves back into your 5th house of creativity, love, the pursuit of joy. If your inspiration has been blocked, this transit reveals why. If you’ve been treating creativity as something to monetize, something to optimize, something to control, this is where that breaks. You can’t force joy. You can’t schedule passion. By April 12, the answer will be clear. What sustains you, and what drains you? What feeds your spirit, and what just takes from it? Creativity and love cannot survive under obligation. If you’ve only been showing up because you said you would, it’s time to choose something else.

entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Venus retrograde is a filter. It strips away the excess, leaving only what is essential. What brings you life. What drains it. What was never real to begin with. It begins in your 5th house of joy, creativity, love. The things that make you feel alive. The things you used to reach for instinctively, before responsibility, before expectation, before you started calling your joy a luxury. An old creative project, a past lover, a feeling you abandoned long ago, they return. But, Do you still want this? Did you just forget why you let it go? Then, on April 3, Venus moves back into your 4th house of home, family, the foundation beneath it all. The past stops being memory and becomes present. A family pattern you thought you’d outgrown reveals itself in a current relationship. A home situation shifts. Maybe you’ve been planning a move. Maybe you’ve already left. Either way, something isn’t settled. By April 12, the truth is in front of you. What do you need to feel at home in your life? In your body? This retrograde is just clearing the static so you can hear it.

entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Venus retrograde strips things down to their core. What’s real stays. What was built on illusion crumbles. It begins in your 4th house of home, family, roots. The foundation. The past. The stories you didn’t choose but inherited. A wound reopens. A pattern resurfaces. Maybe it’s something you thought you were done with. Maybe it’s something you tried to outrun. But here it is, waiting to be acknowledged. On April 3, Venus moves back into your 3rd house of words, communication, connection. The way you speak. The way you listen. A conversation you thought was over starts again. An old friend, a sibling, a piece of writing you never finished, all asking for attention. If you’ve been avoiding a truth, it won’t stay quiet. If there’s something unsaid, it will find a way out. By April 12, clarity arrives. Your words hold power. Be deliberate with them. Say what needs to be said. Nothing more. Nothing less.

entries.text: Venus retrograde is a clearing. A reset. A space where noise falls away so you can hear what’s been waiting underneath. It starts in your 3rd house, the house of voice, thought, and connection. A conversation returns, an idea resurfaces, a project you abandoned calls your name. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to write, to speak, to create. Ask yourself, what have I been waiting for? The hesitation isn’t coming from time. It’s coming from you. Then, on April 3, Venus moves back into your 2nd house of worth and resources. Money asks to be reconsidered. Not just how you earn, but how you value yourself. The numbers in your bank account tell a story. What you’ve accepted, of what you’ve settled for, of where you’ve traded your time for too little. If there are debts, both literal and unseen, they surface now. The things you’ve given without return. The places you’ve invested without intention. Where have you been underselling yourself? Where have you accepted less than what you deserve? By April 12, clarity arrives. You will know what to ask for.

entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Venus retrograde moves through your 2nd house of material security and self-worth before backtracking into your 1st house of identity and personal power. It begins with money. How you spend it, how you save it, and what it represents. Financial matters from the past reappear, debts call for repayment, and investments demand reassessment. But beneath the surface, this retrograde is about far more than money, it’s about worth. If you’ve been tying your value to what you produce, what you own, or how others perceive you, Venus retrograde exposes the cracks in that foundation. Then, on April 3, Venus moves back into your 1st house of self and identity. This is where things get personal. You may feel lost in nostalgia, questioning who you are and what you truly desire. A past relationship might re-enter your life to remind you who you were. If you’ve been defining yourself by how others see you, this transit will strip that illusion away. By April 12, your sense of self will have shifted. The old version of you has served its purpose. The new one is waiting to take its place.

entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: The year opens with Mercury retrograde in Aries and Pisces (March 15–April 7), a pairing that invites us to harmonize fire and water - action and intuition. Aries emboldens us to act, but Pisces reminds us to feel. During this retrograde, we’re asked to confront how impulsivity may have overridden inner wisdom. This is where the story begins — by slowing down and returning to ourselves, we set the stage for what’s to come. The lesson: Reconnect with your intuition before charging forward.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: In the heat of summer, Mercury retrogrades entirely in Leo (July 18–August 11), shifting the focus to self-expression, creativity, and authenticity. After the reflective waters of Pisces and the fiery urgency of Aries, Leo brings the question: What do you have to say? This chapter is about refining the ways we share our gifts with the world. We must ensure that our outward expression matches our inner truth. The lesson: Reclaim your voice.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The final act unfolds with Mercury retrograde in Sagittarius and Scorpio (November 9–29), asking us to explore our beliefs and dig into the deeper truths that shape our lives. Sagittarius invites us to question what we know and seek broader perspectives, while Scorpio demands that we face the shadows we’ve been avoiding. This retrograde is the culmination of the year’s work — a deep dive into the stories we’ve been telling ourselves and a chance to rewrite them from a place of clarity and transformation. The 2025 Mercury Rx Lesson: Challenge outdated beliefs and align with your deeper truths.

entries.text: The first Mercury retrograde of 2025 begins in fiery Aries, a sign known for its boldness and decisiveness, before slipping back into the dreamy, intuitive waters of Pisces. This is a call to revisit our actions, particularly where impulsivity has overshadowed intuition. Aries pushes for immediate results, while Pisces reminds us to pause, reflect, and trust the unseen. The cazimi moment on March 24 offers a rare window of clarity amidst the confusion, pay attention to insights around this time.

entries.text: The pre-shadow begins February 28, offering a quiet hum of the themes to come: missteps taken in haste, decisions made without consulting the quieter voices within. As Mercury stations retrograde at 9°35 Aries on March 14, the energy snaps taut. Aries demands motion, but Mercury’s reversal halts us mid-stride, turning our attention to the places where recklessness has led to unintended consequences. The Aries retrograde asks: What fires have you ignited without considering the burn?

entries.text: The cazimi on March 24 at 4°24 Aries is a moment of sharp clarity amid the confusion, the brief still point where Mercury’s retrograde journey aligns perfectly with the Sun. Here, insights flare like sparks from a struck blade. Pay attention to what becomes clear now—this is the retrograde’s heart, where the lessons crystallize before Mercury slips further back into the mists.

entries.text: As Mercury retreats into Pisces on March 30, the tone shifts dramatically. What was once a battlefield becomes a maze of feeling, memory, and half-spoken truths. Pisces has no taste for the straightforward; it asks us to navigate the unseen, to interpret what cannot be said outright. Miscommunications during this phase stem from subtle undercurrents, from things left unsaid or misunderstood. Here, Mercury trades Aries’ fiery roar for the silent language of dreams, intuition, and emotion.

entries.text: When Mercury stations direct on April 7 at 26°49 Pisces, the journey doesn’t end so much as it loops back on itself. The post-shadow phase, stretching until April 26, offers the chance to integrate what’s been uncovered, to temper action with wisdom and intuition. This retrograde is a trial by fire and fog, teaching us that clear sight requires both boldness and quiet trust in the unseen.

entries.text: The midsummer Mercury retrograde in Leo, a sign that rules creativity, self-expression, and leadership. Mercury in Leo amplifies our desire to speak from the heart and take center stage, but when retrograde, it demands a rethink of how we project ourselves into the world. It's a call to step back from the spotlight and reevaluate how you shine. Leo, the sign of creativity, self-expression, and leadership, invites boldness, but under Mercury’s retrograde, it demands introspection. This is not about dimming your light but ensuring that the light you project is genuine and aligned with your truth. From June 29, as Mercury enters its pre-shadow, themes of authenticity, pride, and recognition begin to surface. Are you living for the applause, or does your expression reflect the core of who you are?

entries.text: As Mercury stations retrograde at 15°34 Leo on July 17, the tension heightens around how you communicate, perform, and share your gifts with the world. Miscommunications may arise in areas where ego or performance have overshadowed vulnerability and authenticity. Old creative projects, forgotten ambitions, or unresolved dynamics in relationships may reappear, offering a chance to revisit and refine. The challenge is to strip away what is performative and lean into what is real.

entries.text: The cazimi moment on July 31 at 9°00 Leo is a rare beam of clarity amidst the retrograde haze. This is the heart of the retrograde, where Mercury aligns with the Sun, illuminating insights about your self-expression. Inspiration flows during this time, but it often points backward—toward ideas, passions, or creative endeavors you may have set aside. Pay close attention to what surfaces now; it carries the seeds of transformation for your creative and personal expression.

entries.text: As Mercury begins its direct motion on August 11 at 4°14 Leo, and through the post-shadow phase ending August 25, the focus shifts to integration. What have you learned about the way you express yourself? Have you been seeking validation, or are you creating from the heart? This retrograde teaches that leadership and creativity are not about dominating the stage—they’re about standing in your truth. Use this time to reconnect with your passion, refine your voice, and ensure that what you share with the world is both authentic and deeply meaningful.

entries.text: The final Mercury retrograde of 2025 begins in Sagittarius (November 9) and retraces its steps into Scorpio, shaking the foundations of our beliefs and challenging the narratives we cling to. Sagittarius, the seeker of truth and expansive horizons, invites us to question the stories we live by. Scorpio, the alchemist of the zodiac, pulls us into the underworld of our psyche to unearth the truths we’ve buried. This retrograde doesn’t just ask what you believe —it asks why, dragging hidden truths and emotional debris into the light.

entries.text: As the pre-shadow phase begins on October 21 at 20°42 Scorpio, the themes of this retrograde subtly emerge. We may notice cracks in our long-held beliefs or find ourselves drawn to reexamine the emotional and psychological underpinnings of our actions. When Mercury stations retrograde on November 9 at 6°51 Sagittarius, the adventure begins. But Sagittarius’ optimism gives way to scrutiny as Scorpio’s influence demands we confront what’s buried beneath the surface. This is no time for blind faith; the retrograde insists on peeling back the layers, revealing the raw, unfiltered truths we’ve avoided.

Here, Mercury aligns with the Sun, piercing through the fog like an arrow. This is the heart of the retrograde, where the insights cut deep but true. It’s not just about recognizing what’s wrong; it’s about understanding what must be dismantled and rebuilt. Expect revelations around emotional patterns, psychological truths, and the structures of belief that shape your life.

The retrograde has peeled back layers, revealing the beliefs, fears, and patterns that no longer serve your evolution. Sagittarius’ invitation to expand and Scorpio’s demand to transform work in tandem, leaving you with a deeper, clearer understanding of who you are and what you stand for.

entries.text: This retrograde is an alignment. It teaches that truth isn’t just what you know — it’s what you embody. It’s a descent into the underworld of the mind and the heart, where truths are unearthed, stripped bare, and reshaped. It’s an initiation—a trial that asks you to leave behind the comfortable lies and emerge on the other side with a hard-won clarity. The story you tell yourself may never be the same again, but it will be truer, deeper, and more alive.

entries.text: For you, Aries, 2025 begins with a Mercury retrograde that’s personal, kicking off in your sign before dipping into Pisces. This first chapter asks you to balance your bold instincts with a quieter, more intuitive approach. Slowing down is not your natural state, but it’s here that you’ll find the clarity to act with intention. The summer retrograde in Leo shifts the focus to how you express yourself creatively and romantically. It’s a chance to refine your passions and ensure that your self-expression truly represents who you are. By the time Mercury retrogrades in Sagittarius and Scorpio in the fall, the spotlight moves to your beliefs and deeper truths. This final chapter challenges you to expand your understanding of the world while confronting the emotional shadows you’ve avoided. Together, these retrogrades teach you that power doesn’t come from impulsivity—it comes from alignment, authenticity, and trust in yourself.

entries.text: The Mercury retrogrades of 2025 lead you on an inward journey, Taurus, calling you to reevaluate your relationship with stability, creativity, and connection. The year begins with an invitation to reflect on subconscious patterns that influence your daily actions. Aries urges bold decisions, but Pisces reminds you that true strength comes from emotional alignment. In the summer, Mercury retrogrades in Leo, asking you to revisit your roots and the foundations of your life. Home and family dynamics may need rebalancing, and you’ll be asked to heal and strengthen the structures that support you. By fall, the retrograde in Sagittarius and Scorpio asks you to dive deep into your partnerships and shared resources. What you uncover here could transform how you approach intimacy and collaboration. The year teaches you that true stability isn’t rigid — it’s adaptable, intuitive, and rooted in your authentic needs.

entries.text: As a Mercury-ruled sign, these retrogrades hit home for you, Gemini, pushing you to rethink how you connect, communicate, and create. In the fall, the retrograde in Sagittarius and Scorpio turns your attention to your closest connections and the stories you tell yourself about partnership. Miscommunications may surface, but they hold the key to deeper clarity and understanding. These retrogrades remind you that communication isn’t just about speaking — it’s about listening, revising, and building bridges.

Together, these retrogrades teach you that alignment isn’t just about outer success — it’s about creating a life that feels deeply nourishing and true to you.

By summer, Mercury retrogrades in Leo, highlighting the need for balance in your daily routines and creative pursuits. The final retrograde in Sagittarius and Scorpio dives deep into your beliefs and emotional patterns, offering clarity and transformation. These retrogrades teach you that intuition is your superpower, guiding you to live and express your truth fully.

entries.text: The lunar nodes, often called the Nodes of Destiny, are celestial markers of the soul’s journey through time. The North Node, a ravenous dragon’s head, marks the uncharted territories your spirit hungers to explore in this incarnation. The lessons yet to be learned, the challenges that call us forward, and the growth that awaits. Opposite stands the South Node, the dragon’s tail, holds the wisdom of what’s been earned in prior incarnations. The skills and tendencies that come as effortlessly as breathing; familiar and comforting, yet all too easy to sink into stagnation if held onto too tightly. Together, they trace a map of where we’ve journeyed and illuminate the path toward where we’re destined to grow.

entries.text: On January 11, 2025, the lunar nodes shift from the Aries-Libra axis to the Pisces-Virgo axis, ushering in an 18-month cycle that centers on learning to balance intuition and analysis, spirituality and practicality. This is the axis of dreaming and doing, vision and action, surrender with the steady grind of effort - themes that will shape 2025 into 2026 (January 2025 to July 2026).
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Pisces / Virgo axis invites you to honor your dreams (Pisces) by surrendering to the unknown, while Virgo, the maker, grounds you in the reality that dreams are not enough; they demand effort, precision, and care to be forged into reality. The challenge of this nodal cycle is to hold both: the boundless expanse of your imagination and the steady groundedness of your actions. The work lies in keeping faith without losing your footing.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Living in this tension between inspiration and practicality is the work of this nodal cycle. It’s not about favoring one over the other but allowing them to work together, each strengthening and balancing the other. The vast, dream-filled expansiveness of Pisces nourishes the garden that Virgo has planted, its waters feeding the soil of intention and care. Meanwhile, Virgo’s structure and precision give form and purpose to Pisces’ creative outpour, shaping visions into reality.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Growth is born from the alchemy of water and earth. Water, like inspiration, moves with a restless hunger, seeping into every crack, awakening what sleeps beneath the surface. Earth, steadfast and patient, cradles the seed, giving it the structure it needs to root deeply and rise steadily. Without water’s life-giving touch, the soil hardens, and the seed withers in its shell. Without earth’s firm embrace, water’s flow scatters aimlessly, leaving nothing to take hold. Together, they are fluid yet grounded, yielding yet enduring—birthing a life that reaches both toward the heavens and into the depths below.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: The polarity of Virgo/Pisces is about balancing order (Virgo) and chaos (Pisces). From disorganization to organization, we are seeking stability within the rise and fall of the emotional waves. Pisces is represented by two fishes swimming in opposite directions, one toward the euphoric highs, the other toward the sabotaging lows—symbolizing the conflict of our emotional currents. Together, they offer a lesson in balance: how to find stability amidst the emotional tides, moving from disorganization to alignment, from overwhelm to clarity. Together, they remind us that both chaos and order have a role to play in the art of creation. The universe rewards both the vision and the effort.

entries.text: The nodes last occupied the Pisces/Virgo axis from June 23, 2006, to December 18, 2007. Looking back on this time can reveal the recurring themes and lessons this nodal shift may bring. Where were you called to balance the practical with the spiritual? How did you navigate the tension between trusting the flow and staying grounded in your day-to-day life? The energies of that time are resurfacing, offering you a chance to revisit, refine, and move through these lessons with greater awareness and intention. Past experiences hold the keys to navigating this cycle with clarity and purpose.

entries.text: From 2006 to 2007, the North Node in Pisces called for spiritual growth, compassion, and the breaking down of boundaries, while the South Node in Virgo urged the release of perfectionism and overly critical tendencies. As the lunar nodes return to this axis in 2025, expect themes from that period to resurface, offering an opportunity for reflection, course correction, and deeper integration of the lessons left unresolved.

entries.text: The rise of social media platforms like Friendster, Myspace, Facebook, and Twitter began to transform global communication, creating a sense of interconnectedness aligned with Piscean ideals. The release of Al Gore's documentary "An Inconvenient Truth" in 2006 brought climate change to the forefront of public consciousness, prompting a collective call to address environmental issue; a reflection of Virgo's concern for the Earth and Pisces' universal compassion.

entries.text: As we move into 2025, the digital landscape mirrors the evolving tides of accountability and care. In November 2024, the Australian Parliament made a bold move, passing legislation that prohibits individuals under the age of 16 from accessing platforms like TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, Facebook, and X (formerly Twitter). This groundbreaking decision aims to safeguard young people’s mental health, shielding them from harmful content and the risks tied to online interactions.

entries.text: This moment marks a shift in the global conversation about technology, security, and connection. Social media, once celebrated as a space for dissolving boundaries and fostering interconnectedness — a true Piscean ideal — now reveals its shadow side: unchecked influence and exploitation. Virgo’s energy steps into this dialogue, demanding discernment, accountability, and action. It reminds us that safeguarding our collective well-being often requires making tough, but difficult choices to ensure safety and integrity in our interconnected world.

entries.text: This shift challenges us to balance the expansive potential of digital connection with systems that prioritize care and safety. Pisces dissolves boundaries, while Virgo calls for discernment and accountability, reminding us that vision must be grounded in sustainable action; even in spaces meant to bring us together.

Together, they create a story about letting go, stepping into our truth, and embracing the messy, beautiful work of becoming.

entries.text: The planetary shifts — Saturn entering Aries, Jupiter entering Cancer, and Uranus entering Gemini — align with the nodal journey of Pisces (North Node) and Virgo (South Node), reinforcing the themes of faith, compassion, structure, and transformation. Saturn in Aries helps ground Piscean dreams, showing us how disciplined belief and bold action can bring our visions to life. It encourages us to take the intuitive guidance of the North Node in Pisces and turn it into real, tangible outcomes, reminding us that faith needs effort to manifest. Jupiter in Cancer, on the other hand, amplifies the call for compassion, helping us nurture the emotional connections that support genuine growth. Its expansive energy aligns with Pisces’ spiritual depth, highlighting that care—both for ourselves and others—is the foundation of true progress. Meanwhile, Uranus in Gemini shakes up the rigid habits tied to the South Node in Virgo, breaking down perfectionism and overthinking to make space for intuitive leaps and fresh, innovative ideas.

entries.text: Neptune in Aries is the fire in the temple’s heart—a divine spark that demands we dream bigger and act boldly. This is the energy of cutting through illusions with the blade of intuition. It calls for creating of new spiritual paths, ones that are unapologetically authentic and fueled by raw creativity. The North Node in Pisces fuels Neptune in Aries’ fire, reminding us to ground our boldness in authentic compassion and creativity. Meanwhile, this dynamic energy challenges the South Node in Virgo’s tendencies toward over-analysis and perfectionism, urging us to embrace a raw, unapologetic authenticity over rigid control. Together, Neptune in Aries and the Pisces-Virgo nodal axis inspire us to forge new, spiritually aligned paths that are as courageous as they are compassionate.

entries.text: Saturn in Aries is a hammer striking an anvil, shaping dreams into something solid and real. It’s the architect of the future, pushing us to build foundations beneath the castles we’ve sketched in the clouds. With the North Node in teaching of faith and surrender, Saturn demands we bring form to the formless. This combination teaches us the “discipline of belief.” It’s not enough to trust in the flow of life; Saturn in Aries reminds us that we must also meet the flow with effort, courage, and a willingness to act. It supports the nodal cycle by grounding Piscean faith in concrete foundations, ensuring that the dream doesn’t remain an abstraction but becomes something real and lasting
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: When Jupiter moves into Cancer, it waters the roots of everything we hold dear. Growth doesn’t just happen outward—it begins in the deep, nourishing soil of emotional connection. This is a time to deepen connections, create a home that can emotionally support you, and prioritize self-care. Jupiter amplifies the North Node’s Piscean call for compassion, reminding us of the transformative power of caring—for ourselves and for others. Growth now comes from empathy and understanding, not from striving for control or domination.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: While Saturn in Aries pushes us to act, Jupiter in Cancer balances this by reminding us that growth is rooted in emotional security and self-care. It supports the nodal shift by fortifying the emotional and spiritual foundations needed to sustain Virgo’s practical efforts and Pisces’ expansive dreams. This energy nurtures the soil from which all creation grows, helping us stay aligned with the deeper meaning behind our actions.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: When Uranus enters Gemini on July 7, 2025, it brings the energy of radical transformation and innovative thinking. Gemini’s quicksilver intellect and Uranus’ revolutionary force disrupt old paradigms, challenging the South Node in Virgo’s tendencies toward over-analysis, perfectionism, and rigid control. Uranus in Gemini clears away the clutter of excessive precision, making space for intuitive leaps and creative breakthroughs that align with the Piscean flow of the North Node.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: This transit also reshapes how we communicate and connect, encouraging us to think beyond logic and embrace intuitive, multidimensional forms of understanding. It supports the nodal cycle by breaking the chains of Virgo’s obsession with order and replacing them with the freedom to experiment, adapt, and trust in the organic unfolding of ideas. Uranus in Gemini electrifies the Pisces-Virgo axis with a sense of possibility, helping us merge intuition and practicality in ways that defy conventional rules.

entries.text: The nodal cycle doesn’t follow a straight path—it spirals. With each turn, it revisits familiar themes, deepening the story and sharpening the lessons. At every crossroads, the nodes challenge you: Will you meet the moment? Will you rise to what fate demands?

entries.text: Every 18.5 years, the nodes call you home. This is your nodal return. It’s the snake swallowing its tail, a cosmic reminder of who you are and why you’re here.

entries.text: When the transiting North Node aligns with your natal North Node (and the South Node with your natal South Node), the universe asks: Will you meet the moment? Will you rise to what fate demands?

entries.text: This event occurs around the ages of 18–19, 37–38, 56–57, and 74–75. In moments like these, life feels filled with a sense of destiny. You may find yourself at a crossroads, faced with decisions that feel both terrifying and divinely guided. Pay attention, this is not the time to shrink from your calling.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: If the nodal return is the homecoming, the nodal square is the trial. It’s the grindstone that sharpens your edges and clarifies your course. When the transiting nodes form a square (90°) to your natal nodes, tension arises. The universe asks: What will you choose when the path forward isn’t clear? Will you confront the resistance, or let it stop you?
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: This event unfolds around ages 4–5, 13–14, 22–23, 31–32, 40–41, 49–50, 58–59, 67–68, and 76–77. The nodal square brings challenges that expose misalignments between your choices and your destiny. It’s a crossroads, marked by external events or inner turmoil that force you to reevaluate your direction. The friction is here to refine you.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: At the nodal opposition, the cosmic wheel turns, and you’re pulled in two directions. The North Node stands where your South Node once was, and the South Node where your North Node began. This is the axis of integration, where the past meets the future, and the universe asks: Have you learned from where you’ve been? Are you ready to step into where you’re going?

entries.text: This event occurs around ages 9–10, 27–28, 46–47, 65–66, and 84–85. It’s a moment of reckoning with the push-pull of your life’s polarity: comfort versus growth, familiarity versus potential. The nodal opposition is the mirror that reflects your journey so far. What have you carried forward that no longer serves you? What lessons from your past must you now embody to step into your becoming?

entries.text:
2025–2026 (Current Node Shift)
With the North Node moving through Pisces in your 12th house of spirituality, rest, and the subconscious, the universe is asking you to slow down and turn inward. Healing doesn’t come from the hustle; it happens in the stillness. This is your time to grieve what needs grieving, untangle what feels knotted, and trust that clarity will come in its own time. Prioritize rest like it’s the most important thing on your to-do list, because right now, it is. This is a season for deep introspection and renewal, a time to face the patterns you’ve buried and let them transform you.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Meanwhile, the South Node in Virgo lights up your 6th house of work and routines, urging you to release perfectionism and the need to measure your worth by your productivity. Micromanaging every corner of your life won’t bring the peace you’re seeking. Let go of the pressure to always be doing, fixing, or achieving. Be fully present with yourself, free from judgment, and let go of the pressure to always do more.

entries.text: This nodal cycle invites you to soften into a more fluid, intuitive way of being. When you let go of the idea that your value is tied to your output, you open the door to a sense of peace and wholeness that no amount of effort could ever buy. Trust in the process of surrender. Healing is happening, even when it feels slow.

You may have felt tension between the demands of daily life and the need for rest or spiritual growth. Reflecting on how you navigated work-life balance and addressed inner healing can provide valuable guidance for this cycle.

entries.text:

A nodal return for Aries Rising highlights the importance of integrating spiritual growth with practical routines. Release the pressure to control every detail and create space for quiet, for rest, for the unexpected. Let go of the urge to push through and instead, ask: what would it feel like to move with intention, rather than force? When you cultivate a softer, more compassionate relationship with yourself, you unlock the healing and strengthen your connection to your inner knowing.

With the North Node moving through Pisces in your 11th house of community, friendships, and future vision, you’re being called to dream not just for yourself but for the collective. This is a time to soften in your social connections, to show up with empathy and compassion, and to imagine the kind of world you want to help create. The South Node in Virgo, activating your 5th house of creativity and self-expression, is here to help you release the perfectionism that might keep you from fully sharing your light. Let go of the need for your projects to be flawless or for every effort to be met with applause. Instead, focus on collaboration. This nodal shift teaches you that what you build together will always feel more meaningful than what you create alone. This moment is an invitation to trust in the process and the people around you.

A nodal return marks a karmic crossroads, a moment to embody the lessons of the nodes in your life. For Cancer Rising, this means stepping into the grounded, service-oriented energy of Virgo in your daily communications and immediate environment. It’s time to refine your voice, focus on the details, and prioritize meaningful interactions that reflect your values. This nodal cycle encourages you to engage in learning experiences that sharpen your discernment and deepen your understanding of the world around you.

Dive into your creative passions, embrace romance with an open heart, and express yourself authentically—without overthinking how it will be received. This period invites you to trust your intuition and let your artistic, playful, and heartfelt sides take the lead. If financial or energetic stress feels like a barrier, reclaiming creative freedom begins with small, deliberate acts. Creativity doesn’t have to be grand; it thrives in moments of presence. Give yourself permission to create without purpose or expectation. Meanwhile, the South Node in Virgo moves through your 11th house of friendships and community, encouraging you to release the need for perfection in your social circles or approval from others. If you’ve been caught up in trying to fit into group dynamics or prioritizing others’ expectations over your own desires, this is your opportunity to let go. This nodal shift is about reclaiming your personal joy and creative freedom. Trust that when you lead with your heart, the right people and opportunities will align with you. Let this be a time to explore what lights you up, unapologetically share your gifts.

2025–2026 (Current Node Shift)
With the North Node moving through Pisces and your 4th house of home, family, and emotional foundations, this is a time to turn inward and reconnect with what truly nurtures you. The cosmos is asking you to cultivate a sense of peace and compassion in your home life, whether by deepening bonds with family, creating a sanctuary that feels spiritually aligned, or exploring your inner emotional world. If family isn’t part of your support system, or if those relationships feel strained, this is your invitation to redefine what “home” and “connection” mean for you. Family doesn’t have to be blood—it can be the friends who show up for you, the community that sees you, or the chosen family you create. Deepen your bonds with those who nurture your spirit, even if it’s just a selected view. This period encourages you to build a foundation rooted in love, care, and understanding—for yourself and those closest to you.

2025–2026 (Current Node Shift)
With the North Node in Pisces illuminating your 3rd house of communication, learning, and your immediate environment, this is a time to soften your approach to how you share your thoughts and connect with those around you. The universe is inviting you to lean into intuitive, compassionate communication—whether through heartfelt conversations, creative writing, or artistic expression. This time also encourages you to nurture relationships with siblings, neighbors, and your local community, finding connections in the spaces closest to home. At the same time, the South Node in Virgo moves through your 9th house of higher learning, travel, and philosophy, encouraging you to release any rigid belief systems or perfectionist tendencies around education and personal growth. If you’ve been clinging to a need for absolute certainty in your intellectual pursuits or an overly structured approach to learning, this is your opportunity to embrace curiosity and open-mindedness instead. This nodal shift asks you to find balance between seeking expansive, big-picture ideas and staying present with the details of daily life. It’s a reminder that wisdom doesn’t always come from far-off adventures or formal studies—it’s often found in the conversations we have, the stories we share, and the connections we make right here and now.

entries.text: This nodal transit invites you to explore creative ways of generating income, prioritize what truly matters to you, and root your sense of self-worth in something deeper than external achievements. At the same time, the South Node in Virgo highlights your 8th house of shared resources, intimacy, and transformation, urging you to let go of perfectionist tendencies when it comes to joint finances or emotional healing. You’re being asked to release the need to micromanage processes that are inherently messy—whether they involve money, trust, or emotional shifts. This nodal shift is about trusting the flow of both material and emotional abundance. By letting go of the urge to control every outcome and embracing a sense of surrender, you create space for greater balance and well-being. It’s a reminder that vulnerability and openness are just as valuable as strategy and precision. This period is about trusting that when you prioritize your values, everything else will fall into place.

This period pushes you to break free from perfectionist tendencies in how you manage shared responsibilities.

The opposition invites you to integrate the two: strengthening your self-worth while allowing intimacy and shared experiences to enhance your emotional and financial growth.

2025–2026 (Current Node Shift)
With the North Node moving through Pisces and your 1st house of self and identity, this is your moment to step fully into your self. The universe is calling you to embrace your compassionate, intuitive, and deeply empathetic nature without hesitation. This is a time to prioritize your personal growth, explore your spiritual path, and express yourself in ways that feel true to who you are. You don’t need perfect circumstances to prioritize your personal growth. Your experiences, struggles, and resilience shape a story that only you can tell, and that story has the power to inspire and connect. Your truth is your strength, and the world benefits when you express it fully. When you lean into who you truly are, without apology or hesitation, you invite others to do the same. The world benefits when you show up as your whole, imperfect, and beautifully unique self.

By letting go of the need to fix or control the dynamics around you, you make room for deeper connection, understanding, and balance. The more you nurture your connection to yourself, the more your relationships and the world around you will reflect that same sense of compassion and care.

Nodal Square
The nodal square challenges you to reconcile your personal identity with the needs of your relationships. You may feel torn between prioritizing your own growth and meeting the expectations of others. For example, you might hesitate to fully express yourself out of fear that it could disrupt harmony in your partnerships, or you may find that focusing too much on others leaves little room for your own self-discovery. This is a time to recognize that being true to yourself doesn’t mean abandoning your connections — it means bringing your whole, authentic self to the table. Growth happens when you trust your instincts and allow your individuality to shine, even as you nurture the relationships that matter most.

Nodal Opposition
During the opposition, you may feel pulled between focusing on yourself and maintaining strong relationships. You may feel conflicted about how much energy to devote to yourself versus your relationships. Perhaps you’ve been over-prioritizing others’ needs, losing sight of your own, or focusing so much on self-improvement that you’ve neglected the give-and-take required in strong partnerships. This is your chance to integrate your personal growth with mutual understanding, creating partnerships that reflect your true self.

entries.text: This Libra Season teaches the difference between honest compromise and self-abandonment. You are learning that being direct is not cruel, and that any relationship that asks you to dilute your voice or constantly self-edit to keep the peace will not hold.

entries.text: The timing matters. What you practice now becomes a mirror when Venus retrogrades from October 3 to November 13, 2026, moving from Scorpio back into Libra. Use this year to build skills you can lean on later. From now through fall 2026, choose small, steady reps: say no to what you do not want, speak up when you have something to add, stop apologizing for having preferences and needs. Name what you need and let your actions align.

entries.text: You will not get it right every time. Some days you will set a boundary and feel grounded. Other days you will agree to something you do not want and have to repair. That is part of learning. Repair is progress. Accountability is love in action.

entries.text: When Venus enters Libra, she exhales. She softens. She remembers who she is. This is her domain. Venus in Libra doesn't chase. She attracts. She doesn't demand. She magnetizes. This is the cosmic lesson of receptive power - the understanding that what is meant for us will find us when we embody our worth with grace. You are learning the alchemy of refined desire. The art of drawing in what you need through the cultivation of your own inner balance and strength.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Relationships become our teachers now, through the delicate art of being wholly yourself while witnessing another in their wholeness. This Venus placement makes mediators of us all. You begin to understand that multiple realities can coexist. Venus in Libra knows that intimacy requires breathing room. This isn't the warmth of fusion. It's the warmth of recognition. Of seeing another clearly because you're not pressed against them. Of appreciation that comes from having space to observe the full person. This sophisticated reserve isn't a wall, it's a frame. It holds the relationship like art holds meaning. Defined edges, boundaries, make the beauty more visible, not less.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Venus in Libra teaches us that we can be warm without burning. Present without consuming. Available without abandoning ourselves. This is the maturity of love. The elegance of knowing that maintaining your own center of gravity makes the dance of two possible.

entries.text: As Libra Season 2025 winds down, Mercury enters its pre-retrograde shadow on October 21. This is the stretch where crossed wires and old dynamics surface so you can practice clearer relating. Treat every mix-up as a cue to slow down, clarify, and say what you mean with care.

entries.text: In the final weeks of the year, you may notice texts getting misread, important talks needing a second pass, and familiar patterns returning when tone gets fuzzy. Use it. Name your intention before you speak. Ask for what you need in simple language. Reflect back what you heard. Put agreements in writing. If tension rises, pause and return when you can listen again. You are not aiming for perfect. You are building a muscle. Repair counts. Accountability counts. Speak your truth with kindness and let your actions match your words.

entries.text: The core question is simple and costly. Can you stay authentic when it may change a relationship you value. When your truth might disappoint someone you care about. When being clear asks you to risk approval so you can keep your integrity.

Let the chips fall where they teach you.

entries.text: The goal isn't to become someone who never compromises or considers others. It's to build relationships where compromise comes from choice rather than fear, where you can be generous without losing yourself, and where your authentic self is not just tolerated but appreciated.

entries.text: The most powerful element in any transformation is your willingness to be authentic. Your truth is your greatest gift to your relationships and to the world.

entries.text: Venus lands in your 7th house of partnerships, and one-on-one relationship becomes a mirror. You're discovering that love doesn't need you to put out your fire. Not at all. But it does ask you to learn the difference between warmth and scorching heat. Your partners need your famous directness, yes. They also need you to slow down and let them finish their sentences. That person sitting across from you? They're not someone to win against. They're teaching you about give and take that you need to learn. When Venus retrogrades through this same space in 2026, these skills you're building now will be everything. Trust me on this.

entries.text: Your ruling planet Venus moves into your 6th house, where daily life happens. Where routine meets beauty. Where work meets worth. You're finally understanding that self-care isn't some luxury you earn after everyone else is taken care of. It's the foundation. When you set a boundary around your workload, you're teaching everyone around you what respect looks like. Start noticing patterns. Which habits drain you? Which coworkers / clients leave you exhausted? This isn't just information, it's data you'll desperately need when Venus retrogrades in 2026 and everything about how you work and serve comes up for review. Your pace is not too slow. Your needs are not too much.

entries.text: Venus lights up your 5th house of creative expression and pleasure, and your voice wants something new. You're learning there's a difference between charm that manipulates and charm that actually reveals who you are. Between making people laugh to avoid intimacy and using humor to create real connection. Date people who can meet you in the deep end. The joy you build now? It becomes your lifeline when Venus retrogrades in 2026.

entries.text: Venus moves through your home and family zone, and the peacekeeping mask starts to crack. The truth is, you’ve been managing everyone’s comfort but your own. Venus wants you to stop apologizing for having needs, to speak up about what you actually want. Home isn’t peaceful if you’re walking on eggshells. Start small: share your real opinion, change a habit, ask for help. These moments teach you that honesty builds safety faster than silence ever could. When Venus retrogrades in 2026, you’ll be ready to hold your ground in the emotional conversations that follow.

entries.text: Venus moves through your 3rd house of communication, and every conversation becomes an opportunity to practice something new. Generosity includes being generous with your truth. Your words carry power. Use them to build bridges that can hold the weight of real connection, not just surface pleasantries. Practice in low-stakes moments. Tell the barista you actually wanted oat milk. Correct someone when they mispronounce your name. These small acts of authenticity prepare you for the bigger truth-telling Venus retrograde will demand in 2026.

entries.text: Venus activates your 2nd house of resources and value, and everything about worth comes into question. Undercharging is not humility. It is self-abandonment. Over-giving is not generosity. It is often fear dressed as service. Start noticing how often guilt follows “yes.” Track how it affects your energy and finances. What you value about yourself sets the tone for how others value you. The groundwork you lay now becomes crucial during the 2026 retrograde, when Venus reviews your entire relationship with worth.

entries.text: Venus comes home to your 1st house, and you become the main character in your own transformation story. You are learning that being likeable and being yourself are not the same thing. True harmony comes from authenticity, not from constant accommodation. Every time you voice your actual preference instead of deferring, you practice being real. Every time you disagree kindly but clearly, you build your authentic self. These are not acts of disruption. They are acts of love for relationships that can hold all of you. When Venus retrogrades through your sign in 2026, you'll need this practiced authenticity. Build it now while Venus supports your courage.

entries.text: Venus moves through your hidden zone, surfacing emotional patterns you’ve ignored. You’ve been the quiet caretaker of everyone’s moods, managing the unspoken tension before it erupts. But Venus is asking you to stop controlling the weather. Let others feel what they feel. Let discomfort breathe. Pay attention to your dreams, your intuition, the truths you keep avoiding. You can’t heal what you won’t face. The self-awareness you build now becomes your shield when Venus retrogrades in your sign next year, bringing massive emotional transformation.

entries.text: Venus lights up your friendship and community zone, highlighting who truly supports your growth. You’re realizing that authenticity and belonging aren’t always found in the same places. This is your cue to notice which spaces energize you and which demand performance. Practice saying no to social obligations that feel draining. The more honest you are about your needs, the stronger your network becomes. These shifts prepare you for 2026, when Venus retrograde challenges you to rebuild your community from the ground up.

entries.text: Venus moves through your career zone, asking you to redefine success. The armor you’ve built around “professionalism” might be blocking connection. Professional doesn't mean inauthentic. Lead from presence, not perfection. Let people see your humanity. This is about building trust, not image. Set clear limits at work, communicate boundaries with authority, and honor your time. What you create now sets the tone for your next professional evolution when Venus retrogrades through this sector in 2026.

entries.text: Venus expands through your 9th house of meaning and belief, and your whole philosophy of love starts evolving. Your unique perspective on relationships is valid, even when it doesn't match conventional wisdom. Your need for independence within connection is not a flaw. This is your time to question old relationship models, test new philosophies, and embrace connection that honors your independence. Freedom and intimacy can coexist if you build them consciously. The wisdom you gain now becomes your compass in 2026, when Venus retrograde tests how deeply you trust your unconventional truth.

entries.text: Venus deepens through your 8th house of intimacy and merged resources. The boundaries between you and others become visible. You are learning where you end and others begin. Which emotional states are yours and which you've absorbed. Venus asks you to practice energetic boundaries while maintaining your beautiful capacity for connection. To be empathetic without becoming enmeshed. Notice when you take on others' feelings as your own. Practice returning emotional responsibility to its rightful owner. Speak honestly about what you need before resentment builds. This work becomes essential in 2026, when Venus retrograde brings deeper lessons around trust, merging, and emotional truth.

entries.text: I don’t usually write weekly astrology forecasts, but this week calls for one. We’re heading into the Aquarius Full Moon, and the energy is heavier than usual. It's harder to move through without clarity. This week ends with seeing a truth you won’t be able to walk back from. A shift, nevertheless, that changes the way you move forward. The kind of realization that doesn’t let you go back to pretending.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Even if you didn’t realize you were pretending. Maybe it was just survival, or it was easier than dealing with the conflict. But deep down, you’ve known for a while that something isn’t working. The constant effort to fix it, fix yourself, or just tolerate it. It’s wearing you down. You’re not showing up as yourself anymore. And if this version of you feels exhausted, reactive, numb, or constantly on edge, that’s not really you.

entries.text: Let’s walk through the week:
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Sunday, August 3: The Sagittarius Moon meets Uranus, and things might not go as planned. A conversation, an interaction, a decision... something reveals more than expected. You might feel the urge to react fast. Don’t. Let the moment settle. Later in the day, Saturn, Neptune, and Pluto offer a more grounded perspective. What outcome are you trying to force, and what happens if you let go instead?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Monday, August 4: The Moon in Sagittarius favors honesty, and often it gets lost in the big picture. You may feel pulled toward things that look promising but aren’t really grounded. Sun semi-sextile Jupiter can amplify the pressure to make something “big” happen. A rare Sun–Uranus quintile offers creative insight, but it might come from an unlikely place. Let it.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Tuesday, August 5: Mercury retrograde in Leo meets Venus in a semi-sextile. You might want to be liked more than you want to be heard. But when the Moon enters Capricorn, emotional fatigue sets in. The pressure to keep it all together catches up. Are you expressing what matters to you, or just trying to avoid a fight?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Wednesday, August 6: Mars enters Libra. You’ll start to see that force isn’t the answer, but neither is avoidance. Mars in Libra teaches you how to fight without burning bridges. But also, to stop negotiating with people who are committed to not understand you, because they want you to "drop it". Chiron stations retrograde at 27° Aries. The pain you thought you’d buried shows up in how you speak, move, and defend yourself. Something you thought was part of your personality? It was a wound. You should know, I hated writing that last line. Because I know how much of your life was built around that wound. It gave you something to hold onto when the rest was chaos. But now it’s burning through your hands. Time to drop it. Venus enters Cancer (late night). You’ll start to crave warmth again.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Friday, August 8: Scorpio Quarter Moon, this First Quarter Moon is a choice point. Notice what you’re tiptoeing around.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Saturday, August 9: Mercury slows to a crawl before turning direct. Communication becomes a mirror. Everyone says what they're thinking out loud, often without meaning to.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Aquarius Full Moon: You’ve felt this building, the tension between your need to belong and your refusal to disappear. Something is about to shift. Venus approaches Jupiter. There is something good coming. But first, you have to stop pretending that this works for you. Ask yourself, what would I do differently if I wasn’t trying to please anyone?
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: This week delivers a moment of truth you can’t ignore. Whether it's your decision directly or shows up through someone else's actions, you’ll see what’s no longer working. And once that happens, the only thing left to decide is what you’re going to do about it.
