entries.text:
Aries
You’ve been operating in survival mode longer than you want to admit. Always stepping up. Always taking the lead. But now the weight of that identity is catching up with you. Chiron retrograde reminds you that what you thought was strength may have started as self-protection. It’s okay to lay it down. This week invites you to stop pushing past your own needs. You don’t have to prove anything to anyone. Let yourself be supported, even if you’re still learning how to receive it. The Full Moon reminds you that connection doesn’t mean weakness. It means you’re human.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Horoscopes for the week of Aug 4th

entries.text:
Taurus
Sometimes the things that make you feel safe are also the things that keep you stuck. This week highlights how hard you’ve been working to maintain a structure that may no longer serve you. Chiron retrograde challenges your ideas about control and what you’ve sacrificed to keep things stable. Venus enters your sign’s element and brings a reminder that real care should not require constant proving. You are allowed to ask different questions now. What if you didn’t have to earn your peace? What if it was something you could simply choose?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Horoscopes for the week of Aug 4th

entries.text:
Gemini
You’ve been bending over backwards to keep things smooth. Adjusting, rephrasing, smiling through it. But Mercury retrograde is putting the focus back on your voice. Not the curated version, but the one you’ve been holding back. Chiron retrograde adds a deeper layer, asking what part of you felt like you had to disappear in order to be accepted. This week, there’s power in choosing clarity over likeability. Let the Full Moon show you who hear's you, and who only tolerates you.

entries.text:
Cancer
You’ve been a little too quiet about what you need. Maybe even not saying it to yourself. Venus enters your sign this week, and while that brings softness, it also brings emotional awareness. You may start to feel the emotional weight of all you’ve carried just to avoid rocking the boat. This week gives you permission to stop apologizing for needing care in the first place. You don’t have to explain why you’re sensitive. You don’t need to justify your boundaries. The Full Moon shows you where your energy is being drained, and how to fix that. You deserve to feel held too.

entries.text:
Leo
You’ve spent a lot of time being impressive. You’re awesome, we know this. You consistently show up strong. But Mercury retrograde is slowing you down long enough to notice the gap between who you are and who you’ve had to be. Chiron retrograde adds an emotional undertone to this reflection. This week reveals how certain patterns of confidence were actually strategies to avoid being dismissed. You don’t need to keep proving yourself. Let the Full Moon reflect the truth of your relationships. If being yourself feels like a risk, it’s time to ask why.

entries.text:
Virgo
There’s only so long you can keep patching the cracks before you realize it’s not about fixing anymore. It’s about realizing that things fell apart to no repair. This week reveals how much energy you’ve used trying to hold together what no longer holds you. Chiron retrograde touches a tender place around responsibility. Maybe you thought your worth came from what you do for others. But this week asks a different question: What if your value isn’t tied to your usefulness? The Full Moon helps you see what’s been draining you. Something needs to shift, and it's pretty likely you know what that is already.

entries.text:
Libra
Mars moves into your sign and brings with it a lesson. Your boundaries are not up for debate. You’ve spent a lifetime managing other people’s emotions and reactions. Chiron retrograde may reveal old patterns around putting yourself last in relationships. This week, you’ll see this behavior for what it is. The Full Moon draws a clear line between what feels aligned and what feels like compromise. You don’t have to keep balancing things that were never yours to juggle.

entries.text:
Scorpio
You’re usually the one who knows what’s really going on. You're intuitive, people can't lie to you. The Scorpio Quarter Moon pushes a truth into your awareness that can no longer be ignored. This is not about controlling the outcome or keeping everything secret. It’s about showing up with integrity. The Full Moon illuminates what you've been holding in. Honesty isn’t always comfortable, but it is freeing. You’re allowed and need to choose yourself first, over loyalty to blood or friendship that is dysfunctional.

entries.text:
Sagittarius
You’re no stranger to silver linings. You know how to reframe, put on a smile, and move on. But this week, something asks you (most likely your sanity) to stop glossing things over. Chiron retrograde touches the places where humor became protection. Maybe you needed that strategy at one point, but now it’s time to let yourself feel what’s real. The Moon starts the week in your sign and brings clarity. By the Full Moon, you’ll have a decision to make: keep minimizing your own experience, or speak from the part of you that’s ready to be honest. You don’t have to keep pretending it’s all okay.

entries.text:
Capricorn
You’ve been keeping it together because someone had to. Chiron retrograde asks you to reflect on the roles you’ve internalized, especially the belief that being chosen requires being useful to others. This week shows you where that belief is holding you back. You don’t need to be anyone’s extra hands, or rock to be worthy of love. Venus entering Cancer asks you to examine how you receive care. Are you letting yourself be supported? The Full Moon brings clarity. Let it guide you back to relationships where you can just be yourself.

entries.text:
Aquarius
The Full Moon in your sign is a wake-up call. Something you’ve been holding onto is falling apart, and deep down, you’ve known it was coming. It’s even possible you’re already on the other side of the impact and beginning to recover. This week brings this situation into sharp focus. With both Mercury and Chiron retrograde, you’re being shown where you’ve compromised yourself and your health, just to hold onto a version of you. How do you feel now? This is your chance to realign with who you actually are, even if that means walking away or accepting that some doors have closed. Be the version of you that supports the life you're in, not what was.

entries.text:
Pisces
You’ve been holding space for everyone else for so long, you might’ve lost track of what your own boundaries even feel like. This week brings a moment of clarity. With Chiron retrograde, you're being asked to notice the part of you that always makes room, always bends, always takes on more than your share. Venus in Cancer shifts the focus back to you, what it feels like to receive support without changing what you need in order to receive it. This week's Full Moon acts as a mirror, and breaking point. Where have you been waiting for someone else to show up, while you’ve been carrying everything on your own? Let this week be the moment you decide things don’t have to keep going like this.

entries.text: Leo brings welcomed warmth and inspiration to our lives during this radiant season. As a heart-centered leader with the Sun as its ruler, Leo ignites a fire within us that calls for authentic self-expression and creative courage. Leo naturally gravitates toward the spotlight, not only from ego, but also the understanding that our creative and passionate fire deserves to be seen and celebrated. This season still carries this theme of being seen, but it moves with a refined light; a controlled burn.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: For some, this Leo Season brings the truth that the life you are projecting (especially online) is really a curated exhibit, than a life you want to live. There’s grief in seeing that clearly. And there’s power in dropping the performance, too.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: This Leo Season doesn’t chase the spotlight. It asks what story you’ve been telling to hold onto it. What part of yourself have you created, or held-back to be liked, approved, adored or accepted. This Leo fire burns a little lower now, with Saturn, Neptune, Chiron, and Mercury all in retrograde. This is a time to sit and reflect on the choices that shaped your prescience, your pride, your path.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This is a Leo Season that brings a lot of reflection. You may be in the middle of deep healing. You may need more rest than action. Let that be all you do this month.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This is a season of truth-telling: why do you show up the way you do. It strips away the roles you’ve played to be accepted, the personas built to impress, and the image that no longer fit. The retrogrades slow everything down so you can’t ignore your reflection in the mirror. Leo’s core desire is to be seen and celebrated. But this year, the invitation is to really take a good look at yourself first.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Saturn retrograde in Aries breaks down every illusion you’ve built around control. It questions how you’ve used force to feel secure. Neptune retrograde, dissolving the fantasies you once called purpose. Chiron pulls your attention to the difference between confidence and self-worth. The core theme of this Mercury retrograde is the story you tell about yourself, and why you need others to believe it.

entries.text: This season is about confronting the "why" behind your actions. If you've been creating, working, or showing up for the sake of validation, applause, or fitting in, that realization will find you. And that’s where the work begins. Be honest. About your image. Your passion. Your art. Your light. Let it come from truth, not strategy or OKRs. Let it be yours.

entries.text: This transit challenges the version of independence you’ve been living. Whether it was built from fear, survival, or a need to prove yourself. It’s about understanding how you use power, where you give it away, and what kind of self leadership actually supports you. During this retrograde, many will experience a deconstruction of their self-image, particularly around themes of independence, courage, personal authority, and the unconscious strategies that have shaped how we relate to others and ourselves. You may find yourself facing old habits: excessive self-reliance, isolating, pushing people away just to prove you don’t need them. Or clinging to others because you never learned how to stand on your own. Both are strategies. Neither are freedom. The key is to distinguish between healthy autonomy and reactive independence born from wounds. This is a restructuring of your relationship to power. How you claim it, how you misuse it, how you give it away.

entries.text: Neptune stationed retrograde on July 4, 2025, at 2° Aries, and will station direct on December 10 at 29° Pisces. For Leo Season, Neptune’s retrograde adds a layer of soul work to the fire.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Leo wants to shine, to be recognized, to create with heart. But Neptune moving backward reminds us that not every dream is rooted in reality. Some were shaped by survival. Some were borrowed. Some were dreamt to be an escape, not to be lived. This transit marks the closing of a long spiritual cycle. Neptune spends roughly 14 years in each sign. Neptune retrograde in early Aries asks us to examine our dreams of who we want to become versus who we actually are. This is a season for asking what part of your ambition was fueled by fantasy, and what part actually feeds you.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Neptune retrograde confronts the illusions shaped by ego, avoidance, and projection. Especially around identity, independence, and strength. Leo’s fire is tempered by emotional honesty now. The spotlight doesn’t just reveal your talent. It reveals your intention.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: What have you been chasing? And who taught you to want it? It brings closure to twelve years of spiritual work, which started in 2011. Neptune in Pisces has asked us to soften boundaries, expand our imagination, and feel what connects us across time, culture, and grief. What you leave behind is illusion. You don’t need to know what the next dream is yet.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: While this transit particularly affects those with planetary placements in early cardinal signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn) or late mutable signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces), its invitation extends to all of us.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Chiron's retrograde through Aries continues its deep work on healing wounds related to identity, self-worth, and personal agency. Starting at 27° Aries and moving back to 22° Aries, this period intensifies our awareness of where we carry shame around our right to exist, to take up space, to assert ourselves.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Chiron Retrograde in Aries
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The shadow zone, beginning April 5, 2025, and extending through April 25, 2026, spans nearly a full year of working with these themes. Chiron retrograde asks us to revisit painful experiences where our autonomy was compromised, where we learned to make ourselves small, or where we developed patterns of either people-pleasing or aggressive defensiveness.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Chiron Retrograde in Aries
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: During Leo Season, this becomes personal. Chiron retrograde asks you to go back to the moment you made yourself small just to stay loved, or just to survive. You don’t have to relive it. But you do have to recognize how it still moves through your choices. Leo Season is about the heart. And the heart can’t lead when it's still negotiating for permission to speak. The healing is slow. The key is to approach these tender spots with the same fierce compassion that Leo season demands, to parent ourselves through the process with both strength and courage.

entries.text: The New Moon in Leo on July 24 at 3:11 PM EDT at 2° Leo arrives as a powerful moment of self-renewal. A return to who you are beneath the roles, expectations, and noise. This lunation sits exactly opposite Pluto retrograde in Aquarius, challenging you to face the version of yourself you had to become just to get by.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Leo New Moon: July 24, 2025
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This opposition brings up questions about the systems you've operated in. Work, family, culture. How those environments shaped or silenced parts of you. This is about recognizing the layers you shed to be accepted and deciding which ones you are ready to reclaim. Think of it as shadow work in broad daylight. Nothing hidden. Nothing off-limits.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Leo New Moon: July 24, 2025
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Mercury retrograde, exalted in Leo, moves close to this New Moon. It asks you to rewrite the story of who you think you are and how you narrate that story to others. If you've recently lost your job, your title, your creative momentum, or the version of yourself you built your identity around, this New Moon does not bypass the grief. It asks what remains. That is what you rebuild from.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Leo New Moon: July 24, 2025

entries.text: Key aspects include a Venus-Mars square, putting pressure on relationships and values. Mars sits near the South Node in Virgo, drawing attention to old patterns of over-functioning, burnout, or self-sacrifice. If you’ve been trying to earn love through perfection or martyrdom, this lunation calls that out. It shows where the act of service is really a deeper need to be seen.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Leo New Moon: July 24, 2025

entries.text: Chiron, active in Aries, offers raw and empowering healing. It reminds you that you have lived through every version of not being chosen. And you are still here.

entries.text: Mercury stationed retrograde on July 18 at 15° Leo and will station direct on August 11 at 4° Leo. The shadow period extends from June 30 to August 25. This retrograde wraps itself around the Leo New Moon, deepening themes of authentic self-expression and identity reconstruction.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Mercury Retrograde in Leo: July 18 - August 11
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The core of this transit is the story you tell about yourself, and why you need others to believe it. This is about letting go of the version of you built to impress, and making space for the one built to live. Leo wants to be heard. Mercury retrograde wants the truth. Together, they ask you to strip the performance from your message and speak from your heart.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Mercury Retrograde in Leo: July 18 - August 11
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: When Mercury is retrograde in Leo, it can challenge your voice, your confidence, and the way you narrate your identity. The terrain here is theatrical, personal, and pride-driven. This is a time to examine how authentic your message really is. You might feel exposed, misread, or unseen. You may feel like the spotlight is on but no one truly sees you. That discomfort leads to the deeper question: who are you when no one else is watching?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Mercury Retrograde in Leo: July 18 - August 11
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Themes that may arise include feeling uncertain about how you’re being perceived, conversations that carry more emotional weight than usual, and the resurfacing of past collaborators or lovers. Creative projects may return for revision. Branding or identity work may require more honest edits.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under Mercury Retrograde in Leo: July 18 - August 11
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The last time Mercury moved retrograde through this part of Leo was in the summer of 2012, when social media was teaching us to package our lives for visibility. In 2025, many of us have learned what it costs to constantly perform. This retrograde offers a chance to rewrite that script and reconnect with the parts of you that were left out to make others comfortable, or to game the algorithm.

entries.text: Mercury stations direct on August 11 at 4° Leo, clearing some of the static that began on July 18. This shift brings clarity to creative confusion, stalled conversations, and identity questions that may have been blurred in retrograde fog.

entries.text: On the same day, Saturn at 1° Aries forms its second sextile with Uranus at 1° Gemini. This rare and constructive aspect supports breakthrough thinking inside existing structures. Not chaos for its own sake, but evolution with intention. Strategic rebellion. Revolution with roots.

entries.text: Venus moves through Cancer during the heart of Leo Season. While Leo seeks visibility, Venus in Cancer reminds us that not everything is meant for the stage. Venus in Cancer wants to feel safe, and some things need to be protected. This transit invites you to check in with your heart. What you’re building, and who it’s really for. What are you investing in? Where in your life do you need more emotional safety, not just validation? How do you balance the need for recognition with the need for emotional safety? This placement favors creative projects that come from a deeply personal place, romantic connections that prioritize emotional security. It asks that your financial decisions reflect your values and your future, not the pressure to appear successful.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: While Leo Season lights up the self, Mars in Libra reminds you that your actions don’t exist in a vacuum. This is a transit that asks you to slow down, tune in, and consider how your desires impact with the needs and boundaries of others. Mars in Libra invites a different kind of strength. The kind that listens before it reacts. The kind that considers timing, impact, and reciprocity. This is action with awareness. In a season full of retrogrades, Mars in Libra becomes the pause that keeps you from pushing too hard, too fast. If you're feeling indecisive, take that as a cue to slow down and ask for more time. What looks like hesitation might actually be discernment. This transit is about how your actions may impact others; and choosing power that includes the people around you. What leadership feels like when it’s rooted in justice.

entries.text: The Full Moon in Aquarius on August 9 at 3:55 AM EDT brings illumination to themes of community, innovation, and our role in collective healing. This lunation asks us to balance Leo's focus on individual creative expression with Aquarius's emphasis on group consciousness and social progress.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Aquarius Full Moon: August 9, 2025
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: What gifts do you have that could serve the larger community? How can your unique creative spark contribute to positive change? This full moon may bring clarity about which groups, causes, or communities truly align with your values versus those you've been involved with out of habit or social pressure. If your gifts don’t feel reflected in the spaces you’re in, it may be time to find new ones.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Aquarius Full Moon: August 9, 2025
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: When you step fully into your creative power and allow your authentic self to shine, you create a ripple effect that touches everyone around you. Your willingness to be vulnerable, passionate, and real gives others permission to drop their masks and do the same.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Aquarius Full Moon: August 9, 2025

entries.text: Leo Season 2025 is a reminder that the world needs your unique light. You are worthy of love. Already deserving to be seen when what you’re sharing is real. The world needs your fire and passion. Undiluted.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.structuralFunction: paragraph under The Aquarius Full Moon: August 9, 2025

entries.text: As the Sun moves into Virgo on August 22, the energy shifts from Leo's grand gestures to Virgo's precise refinement. This transition, happening while multiple planets are still retrograde, suggests that any insights or creative breakthroughs from Leo season will need to be carefully integrated and practically applied. What you name in Leo, you build in Virgo. Virgo season doesn't care about what you say, it cares if you practice what you preach. Just you, the work, and what still matters when the spotlight’s off.

entries.text: This Leo season hits your solar fifth house of creativity, romance, and self-expression, but with Saturn retrograde in your sign and Mercury retrograde wrapping around the Leo New Moon, you're being asked to rewrite your entire approach to joy, creativity, and self-worth. Your fierce independence is powerful, but it’s time to look at where it’s become a shield instead of a strength. This isn’t about proving anything. You're allowed to be happy and make things that don't impress anyone but you.

entries.text: When Mars moves into your house of partnership on August 6, it puts the focus on how you show up in close relationships. You’ll need to balance your renewed sense of self with the needs of those you’re connected to. Then on August 11, the supportive sextile between Saturn and Uranus may bring a surprising but helpful shift. Especially in how you build your creative projects or navigate romantic dynamics. Something stable could come out of what first feels unexpected.

entries.text: Mercury Retrograde in Leo (Your 5th House) Mercury retrograde moves through your fifth house, asking you to revisit your relationship with creativity, joy, and self-expression. You're allowed to make things that don't impress anyone but you. You're allowed to love without wondering if it makes you look weak. With Leo in the mix, the pride factor runs high. You might've pushed down certain desires because they didn't fit the image you've been trying to keep up.

entries.text: Maybe you've been performing the role of "artist" or "innovator" based on what others expect, rather than what feels real to you. Maybe you've stopped creating altogether because of fear, rejection, or burnout. This retrograde offers a chance to explore what your creative voice sounds like when you're not editing it for someone else's comfort.

entries.text: Leo New Moon (July 24) The Leo New Moon lights up your creativity area, asking you to get back to what makes you feel alive. If you've been through a breakup, lost your job, hit a wall with your art, or just felt burnt out, this is the turning point. This is the moment to stop playing small and choose yourself.

You may start to question how you’ve been showing up in the world and whether certain parts of your identity still feel true. This is a time to look at the habits, roles, or traits you’ve developed out of necessity or survival, and begin to let go of the ones that no longer work for you.

entries.text: Chiron Retrograde in Aries (Your 1st House) Chiron retrograde in your sign continues the deep healing work around your right to exist and take up space. With Chiron exalted in Aries offering raw but empowering healing, you're being reminded that you've lived through every version of not being chosen, overlooked or left behind and you're still standing. This isn’t about waiting for someone else to see your worth. It’s about claiming it yourself.

If you've been burning yourself out trying to earn validation or followers, this is a moment to stop and rethink.

entries.text: Leo season shines a light on your fourth house, bringing attention to home, family, and the emotional roots that ground you. Home isn't just where you live. It's how you live with yourself. At the same time, Uranus keeps shaking things up in your first house. This creates tension between the desire for stability (always important to you) and being pushed to evolve. Real security isn’t about controlling every detail around you. It comes from being rooted in who you are, even when life feels uncertain.

entries.text: Mars in Libra brings more harmony in how you move through each day. Then on August 9, the Full Moon lights up your career. Quiet, consistent efforts, long overlooked, may finally get the attention and recognition they deserve. Mercury retrograde brings up family patterns that shaped how you show up in love and relationships. If you're still trying to earn peace through control, or love through silence, it's time to ask, who taught you that? With Leo in the mix, pride and protection go hand in hand.

You may find yourself wanting to redecorate, move, or somehow transform your living situation to better reflect who you're becoming.

entries.text: Saturn Retrograde in Pisces (Your 12th House) With Saturn retrograde in your twelfth house, you're doing deep spiritual and psychological work that may not be visible to others but is fundamentally changing you. Old patterns of self-doubt, hidden fears, and unconscious limiting beliefs are surfacing for you to look at. This can feel overwhelming, but remember that anything leaving your psyche right now was mostly holding you back.

entries.text: Venus in Cancer Venus, your ruling planet, spends most of Leo season in nurturing Cancer, highlighting your communication sector. This is a powerful time for honest, heartfelt conversations. Especially with those closest to you. If there’s been tension or distance in certain relationships, this transit offers a chance to reconnect and repair. Words carry weight now, and when spoken with care, they can begin to heal what’s been unspoken for too long.

entries.text: Neptune Retrograde Neptune retrograde is moving through your tenth and eleventh houses, inviting you to take a closer look at your career path and the people you surround yourself with. You might feel a bit unclear or unsettled right now . This is a time to check in with yourself: Does the work you’re doing reflect what you truly care about? Are your communities lifting you up or holding you back? Let the questions guide you. Even if the answers aren’t immediate, this reflection can open the door to more clarity and aligned change.

entries.text: Leo season brings a boost to your communication style, encouraging you to speak with more clarity and confidence. At the same time, Uranus continues its quiet work in your twelfth house, pushing for deeper reflection and spiritual growth. You may feel pulled between wanting to share your thoughts openly and needing time alone to process. Both are important. When Mars moves into your house of creativity and romance on August 6, it brings fresh energy to your passion projects and personal connections. This is a great time to take action on ideas that light you up or to reconnect with joy in your relationships. The Aquarius Full Moon on August 9 could bring clarity or closure to something related to learning, travel, or getting your voice out into the world. Your mind is one of your greatest assets, especially when you allow it to stay flexible and open. Trust your ability to connect the dots.

entries.text: Mercury Retrograde in Leo (Your 3rd House) As Mercury retrogrades through your third house, you are being asked to reflect on how you communicate. Your words matter. So does the tone. You may revisit an old conversation or relationship where something important was left unsaid. Or worse, where something important was said and dismissed.

entries.text: This retrograde is less about talking and more about listening. You do not need to prove your intelligence. You do not need to fill every space of silence. If the words do not come easily, that is okay. Take your time. Let clarity be more important than charisma.

Your curiosity is sharper now. You don’t need all the answers to begin. Just a willingness to show up.

Are your friendships grounded in shared values, or have some simply become routine? You may feel yourself naturally pulling back from certain groups. Pay attention to who energizes you and who drains you. It’s time to build a community that reflects who you’re becoming, not just where you worked or been.

entries.text: Saturn-Uranus Sextile (August 11) On August 11, a supportive connection between Saturn and Uranus may bring a moment of clarity around your career or long-term goals. Uranus is working behind the scenes in your twelfth house, making change, while Saturn helps you structure what’s next. A sudden insight or opportunity might show up that seems unexpected, but in truth, it’s the result of the deep work you’ve been doing. Trust that your inner growth is starting to take shape in the outer world.

entries.text: Venus in Cancer With Venus highlighting your financial house, this is the moment to pause and make thoughtful, grounded money decisions. Instead of chasing quick wins, focus on creating lasting stability. It might be helpful to connect with a financial advisor or someone you trust who can offer clear, supportive guidance. Whether you're building a savings plan, setting new goals, or investing in what genuinely supports your well-being, let your choices reflect care, clarity, and long-term vision. Remember, how you manage your money often mirrors how you care for yourself.

entries.text: As Leo season unfolds, you're still settling into the changes and intentions that came with your recent birthday season. This is a great time to reflect on what truly matters to you. Leo is lighting up the part of your chart that deals with values and resources, asking you to get clear on how you want to invest in yourself moving forward. On August 6, Mars brings fresh energy to your home and family life. You might feel motivated to make changes in your living space, have important conversations with loved ones, or address lingering tension. Then, the Aquarius Full Moon on August 9 puts the focus on shared resources or close partnerships. Something that felt murky before may start to come into focus, especially around finances or emotional commitments. And remember: your sensitivity isn’t something to hide or fix. It’s a strength. It helps you show up with compassion, stay connected to your intuition, and offer care in ways that are deeply healing for you and the people around you.

entries.text: Mercury Retrograde in Leo (Your 2nd House) This retrograde moves through your second house, which speaks to your values, resources, and sense of worth. You might be looking at your bank account or your paycheck and thinking, something's not adding up. Maybe it's time to renegotiate your rates/salary or role. You're starting to see how much of your self-worth has been tied to how much you hustle.

entries.text: A past relationship may come to mind. The one that made you feel like you had to constantly do more to remain in the relationship. Where your worth was measured by what you could offer, not who you are. This is a chance to stop that cycle, if it still exists. No relationship, no job, no amount of success is worth abandoning yourself for.

This is an excellent time for self-care, beauty treatments, and activities that help you feel more like yourself. You may find it easier to express your natural warmth, and people are likely to respond to that energy. Let this be a time to focus on what makes you feel more like you.

Are you working toward something that feels meaningful to you, or have you been chasing goals that were never really yours to begin with? This is a valuable time to pause and reflect. You don’t have to have it all figured out, but it’s worth asking whether your current direction still fits where you really want to go.

entries.text: Chiron Retrograde in Aries (Your 10th House) Chiron retrograde is highlighting deeper patterns in your career, especially around how you see your own value and how you’ve been treated by authority figures. This is a powerful time to notice where you’ve downplayed your expertise or accepted less than you deserve. You’re being called to heal old professional wounds and your relationship with authority. You may be uncovering ways you've diminished your own expertise or allowed others to undervalue your contributions.

entries.text: Happy Birthday, Leo. This is your season, but it may feel very different from what you're used to. With Mercury retrograde in your sign surrounding your birthday New Moon, and several outer planets also in retrograde, this time is less about outward celebration. It’s about maturing, and getting honest with yourself.

entries.text: Venus in Cancer from July 30 to August 25 activates your twelfth house, bringing a more inward focus to love, creativity, and healing. You might feel pulled toward solitude, journaling, or spiritual practices that help you reconnect with yourself. Mars enters your communication house on August 6, giving you fresh momentum to express what you’ve been quietly figuring out. Then the Aquarius Full Moon on August 9 could bring clarity or closure in a relationship, especially one that challenges your independence or growth. When Mercury stations direct on August 11, you come out of this with a stronger sense of direction and self-worth. Let go of the need to brand your personality, you are not a product.

You might start questioning how people really see you. Maybe you feel misunderstood or like no one's getting the full picture.

entries.text: An old relationship could creep back into your mind. Not because you want them back, but because you realize you're still carrying the version of yourself you created just to make it work. It's not about them anymore. It's about the version of yourself you created when you were together. This is a chance to rewrite your story.

entries.text: Leo New Moon (July 24) The Leo New Moon falls in your first house of identity, exactly opposite Pluto retrograde in Aquarius. This opposition is challenging you to face the version of yourself you've had to become just to get by. It's about seeing the layers you've shed to be accepted, and deciding which ones you're ready to reclaim. This is shadow work done in broad daylight.

entries.text: If you've recently lost your job, your title, your creative momentum, or the version of yourself you built your identity around, this New Moon doesn't bypass that grief. It asks: what's left? That's what you rebuild from.

entries.text: Pluto Retrograde Opposition During this retrograde, you may feel exposed or misunderstood. Like you're being seen, but not truly recognized. It can bring up a deep sense of invisibility, as if the spotlight is on you, but no one’s really paying attention to who you are beneath the surface. This is a powerful moment to ask yourself: would you still be doing what you’re doing if no one else was watching? The Pluto opposition is pushing you to confront the ways you've dimmed yourself to fit into systems that were never built to hold your full brilliance.

Chiron in Aries reminds you that you've survived every moment of being overlooked or unchosen. You're still standing.

entries.text: Leo season activates your twelfth house, bringing a natural focus to rest, reflection, and inner work. This is a quieter period meant for processing, integrating, and preparing for what’s next. As your birthday season approaches, think of this as the deep breath before the new chapter begins. When the Sun enters your sign on August 22, you’ll start to feel clearer and more energized about your direction.

entries.text: Mars in Libra lights up your financial house, motivating you to take action on money matters and create more balance in how you earn, spend, and save. Use this momentum to make grounded choices that support your long-term goals. Your strength lies in your ability to see beneath the surface. When you turn that insight inward, it becomes a powerful tool for healing and growth. With several planets in retrograde, the current energy supports your natural rhythm. This reflective, inward pace aligns with your tendency to think things through and process deeply. This is your strength, and this season gives you full permission to lean into it.

entries.text: Mercury Retrograde in Leo (Your 12th House) This retrograde hits your twelfth house, which means it's time to fall back and get quiet. If you're feeling drained or pulled inward, don't fight it. That's your system telling you to unplug from the noise and sit with yourself. Your gut's trying to talk. Old memories, regrets, or fears might creep in, to get your attention.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: You don't have to fix everything right now. You don't even have to make sense of it yet. Sit with it. Journal. Meditate. Listen. The upcoming Leo New Moon arrives right in the middle of this retrograde and offers you a vision. Let the endings and beginnings happen without trying to control how they unfold.

entries.text: Saturn Retrograde in Pisces (Your 8th House) Saturn retrograde in your eighth house is a call to do the deeper work. The kind that doesn’t always come with quick results, but creates lasting change. This part of your chart speaks to transformation, shared resources, trust, and the emotional contracts we enter with others.

entries.text: During this retrograde, you're being asked to look at how you relate to power: when you try to hold it, when you give it away, and what control has cost you. This is also a time to reflect on your relationship with intimacy. Where you let people in, and where you’ve learned to shut down to protect yourself. You don’t have to solve it all right now. But you do have the chance to become more conscious of the patterns that have shaped you.

entries.text: Neptune Retrograde Neptune retrograde is moving through your sixth and seventh houses, inviting you to take a closer look at how you care for yourself and how you show up in relationships. You may feel a bit uncertain about your routines, your work, or your health habits; and that discomfort is asking you to pause and reassess. Are your daily choices truly supporting your well-being? While things may feel foggy at first, this retrograde offers the chance to clear away illusions and reconnect with what’s honest, healthy, and aligned.

This is a good time to nurture the bonds that feel genuine and grounding. The ones where you’re accepted as you are. Surround yourself with people who feel like home, and let those relationships remind you what real connection looks like.

At the same time, Mars is about to enter your sign on August 6, giving you a strong boost in energy, drive, and focus. This is a great time to take action on the ideas or plans you’ve been holding back on. Just make sure your steps reflect what truly matters to you, not just what keeps the peace.

Your patience and ability to see things from multiple angles are key strengths now, not just for yourself, but in helping others find clarity too.

entries.text: Friendships may shift now. The ability to change friendship groups is a luxury. Not everyone gets to walk away from community, even when it stops feeling aligned. If you do have that choice, use it wisely. Are you surrounding yourself with people who see you for who you are or for what you offer? This retrograde invites you to reclaim your future. Start with the people who've shown up for your healing, not just your accomplishments.

Use your natural ability to bring people together to help build something that reflects your values and contributes to real, lasting impact.

entries.text: Saturn Retrograde in Pisces (Your 7th House) Saturn retrograde in your seventh house is inviting you to take a closer look at the foundations of your key relationships. This is a time to be a little more honest with yourself. Are your partnerships rooted in mutual respect, shared values, and clear communication? Or have they been shaped by people-pleasing, conflict avoidance, or dependency? This is a time to strengthen what’s solid and rework what’s not, so your relationships can support the version of you that you're maturing into.

This is a great time to nurture professional relationships and connect with people who value authenticity over image. When your work aligns with what matters to you, success feels more meaningful and sustainable.

entries.text: Neptune Retrograde Neptune retrograde is moving through your fifth and sixth houses, encouraging you to reflect on how you express yourself and how you care for your daily life. You may feel uncertain about whether your creative outlets still reflect who you really are, or you might notice that certain habits no longer support your wellbeing. This is a chance to explore new ways of creating and new routines that feel more aligned with your present self. Even if things feel unclear at first, clarity often follows when you're willing to ask questions.

entries.text: Leo season lights up your career and public life, offering chances for recognition and growth. But with several planets in retrograde, the spotlight may fall on work you've done quietly, behind the scenes, rather than your most recent efforts. Your ability to stay focused and build steadily without needing constant validation becomes one of your greatest strengths right now.

entries.text: On August 6, Mars enters your twelfth house, energizing your inner world. This is a time to pour your focus into rest, healing, and spiritual practices. Projects that require deep thought or privacy benefit from your attention now. The Aquarius Full Moon on August 9 brings something to light at home or within your family life. A shift in your foundation may offer closure, insight, or the space to move forward. The intensity of this retrograde season actually suits your natural depth and psychological awareness. While others may be struggling with the confusion and delays, you understand that real transformation happens slowly and often invisibly.

You may feel uncertain about your path. You may even feel like you're starting over.

entries.text: Saturn Retrograde in Pisces (Your 6th House) Saturn retrograde in your sixth house is your invitation to slow down and get honest about your day-to-day life. Your routines, work habits, and the way you care for your body and time. Are your current patterns truly sustainable, or are they built around overextending yourself? This is a chance to reassess where you may be putting others' needs ahead of your own, and to create a more balanced, intentional approach to work and wellness. Your energy is a resource, and this is your moment to treat it with the care and respect it deserves.

entries.text: Chiron Retrograde in Aries (Your 6th House) This transit encourages you to look at how you balance caring for others with caring for yourself. It brings attention to the ways you may have used work, helping, or striving for perfection as a way to avoid dealing with your own emotional needs. Now is the time to step back and ask whether the way you’ve been showing up is truly sustainable. The goal isn’t to stop being supportive; it’s to do it in a way that also supports you.

entries.text: Venus in Cancer (Your 9th House) Venus in Cancer moving through your ninth house is a reminder that growth doesn’t always come from effort. It often starts with curiosity. This is a great time to explore ideas, practices, or teachings that help you see life from a broader perspective. Whether it’s diving into a new subject, reconnecting with a spiritual path, or simply asking bigger questions, give yourself permission to expand.

entries.text: Leo season activates your ninth house, encouraging you to reflect on what you believe and why. With so many planets retrograde, the adventure now is internal. This is your chance to reexamine your values, your worldview, and the stories you’ve been telling yourself. Mars entering your friendship zone on August 6 brings energy to collaborative projects and shared goals, while the Aquarius Full Moon on August 9 may help clear up confusion around communication or learning.

Your beliefs, your goals, your vision of the world and your place in it; this is all changing. That can create some serious mental conflict. You might find yourself torn between what you've always believed and what actually feels true now.

entries.text: The old version of your worldview might not fit anymore, but letting go of it can feel like losing a part of yourself. It's uncomfortable. You don't have to have it all figured out to be moving in the right direction. You might find yourself going back to something you once studied or reconnecting with a spiritual practice you left behind. If the way you've been seeing the world feels tight or outdated, let it fall apart a little. That's how growth works.

entries.text: Leo New Moon (July 24) True wisdom isn’t static. It grows as you do. This is a powerful time to set intentions around growth, learning, and self-expansion. This New Moon invites you to outgrow the beliefs that no longer reflect who you are, and to step into a version of learning that’s both humble and inspiring. Growth is a two-way street, and you don’t have to know everything to be a guide for others.

entries.text: Saturn Retrograde in Pisces (Your 5th House) Saturn retrograde in your fifth house asks you to get honest about what joy means to you; and what’s been getting in the way of it. This is the part of your chart that speaks to creativity, romance, and self-expression. Where have you abandoned a creative impulse because it didn’t seem practical enough? This retrograde is here to help you connect with joy as a foundation with more intention, so your creative energy has the structure it needs to thrive.

It’s time to look at how you give and receive support. Are you holding back out of fear, or giving more than you have to keep the peace? Real connection requires vulnerability, and you're ready for the kind of closeness that’s built on mutual care, not quiet sacrifice.

entries.text: Leo season brings your focus to transformation, shared resources, and the emotional layers you don’t always show to others. At the same time, Saturn retrograde in your fourth house is encouraging you to take a closer look at what makes you feel safe and grounded. Whether that’s your physical home, family, or inner emotional base. This is deep inner work that may not be obvious to others, but it’s reshaping your foundation in important ways.

entries.text: Mars enters your career zone on August 6, giving you a boost of motivation to pursue professional goals. And the Saturn-Uranus sextile on August 11 could bring helpful, creative solutions to any home or family-related challenges you’ve been facing. As a Saturn-ruled sign, you’re built for this kind of season. While others may feel slowed down or discouraged by retrogrades, you know that true progress requires reflection, discipline, and patience. This is your time to lay the groundwork. To build what lasts. To trust the process, even when no one else sees the bricks being laid.

entries.text: Mercury Retrograde in Leo (Your 8th House) Mercury is retrograde in your eighth house, it's time to get real about your money, your secrets, and your close ties. You might be dealing with old financial messes, divorce, past hookups, or emotional deals you never really closed. This is a time to reflect on what you share and what you keep private. Power struggles may emerge in your close relationships. Who's actually in control here, and why?

entries.text: Because this retrograde is in Leo, pride, ego, and performance are part of the equation too. You may notice how often you've pretended to be fine just to avoid looking messy. You may see where you've clung to control so you wouldn't have to admit you were hurt. Leo wants to be seen, but in the eighth house, it's about being seen by the people who matter. If you have given too much or withheld too long, this retrograde offers a moment to fix things.

You're learning to stop waiting for others to provide the emotional security you need, and to start building it for yourself.

Leo season brings your focus to partnerships and significant relationships, highlighting the balance between your need for independence and your desire for deep connection. With current Aquarian influences in the mix, you may feel pulled between wanting freedom and craving closeness.

entries.text: The Full Moon in your sign on August 9 marks an important turning point. It could bring clarity about your path or recognition for the unique contributions you’ve been making. Especially the ones that set you apart. Mars in Libra energizes your ninth house of learning and big-picture thinking, encouraging you to share your insights, teach, or explore new perspectives. With multiple planets in retrograde, the pace may feel uncertain, but that actually works in your favor. While others may be struggling with the lack of clear direction, you’re at home in the gray area. You thrive when questioning old systems and imagining something better. Your gift is your vision. You see possibilities others overlook. The challenge, and the opportunity, is learning to express those ideas in ways people can connect with. The more you ground your insights in relatable language, the more powerful your impact becomes.

Conversations with lovers, exes, business partners, or close collaborators may need to be revisited. Old arguments might resurface. Unspoken tension might finally get aired out. With Mercury retrograde in Leo, pride, ego, and attention start playing a bigger role in your relationship stories. Are you trying to win the argument, or be understood?

If you're showing up loud and proud on the outside but feeling neglected or resentful on the inside, it's time to check the gap between the performance and the truth. This is a time to revise the stories you tell about love and partnership.

What have you already discovered about your creative voice? Let your past breakthroughs take root.

entries.text: Venus in Cancer (Your 6th House) Venus in Cancer moving through your daily routine sector reminds you that self-care lives in the details. It’s not just about taking breaks, it’s about how you show up for yourself in the little moments each day. The tone you set in your morning, the way you speak to yourself when you're tired, the small choices you make around food, movement, and rest. All of it adds up. This transit encourages you to bring more care, intention, and emotional presence into your daily habits, because how you live day to day is what ultimately supports your long-term well-being.

It’s a good time to bring more structure and consistency to the practical parts of your life. With Neptune, your ruling planet, retrograde for most of this period, you’re being asked to get clear about the difference between healthy escapism and true rest, between intuition and avoidance.

The more you embrace that, the more powerful and grounded your presence becomes.

But in the sixth house, that glow has to be built on rest, balance, and boundaries.

You might be out here saying everything's fine, posting about clean eating or productivity hacks, but skipping meals, losing sleep, or staying in environments that silently drain you. That disconnect catches up. This retrograde exposes the gap between what you say is healthy and what actually is. Your time and energy are sacred. Treat them like it.

entries.text: Neptune Retrograde in Pisces (Your 1st House) Neptune’s retrograde from Aries back into late Pisces signals the closing of a major chapter in your personal and spiritual growth. Since 2011, you’ve been building a deeper relationship with your intuition, letting go of old beliefs, and learning to see yourself more clearly. Now, the focus shifts to integration: taking everything you've learned and figuring out how it fits into your day-to-day life. You might feel more connected to your inner guidance, but also a little unsure about who you are now that some of the old roles and identities no longer apply. That’s normal.

entries.text: ​​2025 invites you to work with your drive in ways that honor both your ambition and your well-being. The North Node in Pisces activates your subconscious and spiritual growth, urging you to trust your intuition and explore unseen realms. Practices like meditation, dreamwork, or creative outlets will help you access this energy. The South Node in Virgo challenges you to release perfectionism in your daily habits and routines. Where can you invite more flow into your structured life? You start the year with Mars retrograde in Leo and Cancer (December 6, 2024 – February 23, 2025), urging you to pause and reconsider your creative spark and emotional reserves. Mars is your ruler, and this retrograde brings your energy inward. In Leo, it asks: What creative fires have you ignored? What creative risks or emotional challenges were you facing in late 2007? Did fear hold you back? This is your moment to reclaim your courage and with the wisdom you’ve gained and choose differently this time. When Mars shifts into Cancer, the focus moves to your foundation. Are you building a life that supports your dreams, or are you running on empty? True power doesn’t come from constant motion. It comes from knowing when to pause, when to rest, when to listen. Around January 2, Mars Rx (1°08 Leo) opposes Pluto (1°08 Aquarius)—notice if you’re pushing too hard or clashing with external power structures. By January 6, Mars enters Cancer, asking you to nurture your inner fire rather than forcing yourself into overdrive. The focus shifts to emotional reserves. This might show up as feeling unusually sensitive or easily drained, particularly if you’ve been ignoring your need for rest. Daily acts of self-care, like cooking a nourishing meal, spending quiet evenings at home, or connecting with loved ones, will help replenish your energy. Watch for moments when you feel like you “should” be doing more; this retrograde teaches that rest is a necessary part of sustaining your drive.

entries.text: March and April bring opportunities for self-discovery, especially around relationships and personal goals. With Venus retrograde starting in your sign, March and April are all about rediscovering your worth. Old relationship dynamics may resurface, offering a chance to heal and rewrite the script. On a day-to-day level, this might look like receiving a message from an ex or being asked to revisit an old project at work. Instead of jumping to react, use this time to reflect on patterns. Are you giving too much without receiving in return? Are you fully recognizing the value of your contributions? Mid-March marks a significant turning point: the March 13 total lunar eclipse (23°56 Virgo) encourages you to refine the rhythms in your daily life, while the partial solar eclipse (9°00 Aries) on March 29 celebrates fresh starts in your personal goals. March’s retrograde in Aries and Pisces reveals cracks in your plans, demanding patience and introspection. Leo in the summer challenges your leadership, does your authority stem from authenticity or pretense? entries.text: The North Node in Pisces asks you to embrace intuition in your communication. Share your ideas even if they’re still forming—they have value just as they are. The South Node in Virgo challenges you to let go of overanalyzing long-term goals. Stay present with the small steps and trust the larger vision will come together. Be present in the moment. Capricorn, you’ll sense the undercurrent of change as soon as Pluto cazimi (1°42 Aquarius) on January 21 reframes how you handle money, values, or self-worth. The year’s start also features Mars retrograde in Leo/Cancer, revealing imbalances in partnerships — look for clarity around January 6, when Mars Rx enters Cancer, prompting deeper emotional introspection. In spring, the Venus retrograde (March 1 – April 12) cycle in Aries/Pisces challenges you to balance ambition with rest, culminating around the March 29 partial solar eclipse (9°00 Aries) that could shift your home base or leadership style. Saturn enters Aries on May 24, testing how you build foundations from the inside out — self-care becomes non-negotiable. By the time Jupiter enters Cancer (June 9), supportive relationships begin to flourish, provided you’ve carved out space for authentic connection.

entries.text: The North Node in Pisces focuses on your personal values, encouraging you to align your finances and resources with your deeper beliefs. What truly sustains you? The South Node in Virgo asks you to release perfectionism in shared ventures. Collaboration requires trust, not constant scrutiny. This is a defining year, Aquarius, largely thanks to Pluto’s presence in your sign and the pivotal Pluto cazimi (January 21) unveiling the next level of your personal evolution. Mars retrograde tangles with Pluto in early January, again on April 26, and once more in late spring, triggering breakthroughs in how you navigate others’ expectations vs. your own needs. Around February 9, a Mercury cazimi (20°59 Aquarius) clarifies communication; use this insight to shape your year’s intentions. When Neptune enters Aries on March 30, your mind hungers for fresh ideas and spiritual perspectives — follow that curiosity. The summer shift of Uranus entering Gemini (July 7) awakens a newfound freedom in your creativity. Lean into any friction come August 8–9, when Mars in Libra opposes Saturn and Neptune. Tension can be your teacher, revealing your next bold step.

entries.text: The Total Lunar Eclipse in Pisces hits on September 7th at 2:08 PM EST like floodwater that's been pressing against a dam for months. It's the first of two eclipses closing out 2025's most intense reset, and it lands while five planetary objects are retrograde. You are not meant to push harder right now, just sit back and observe.

entries.text: The eclipse at 15° Pisces forms a trine with Jupiter in Cancer, while Neptune, Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, and Chiron are all retrograde. In plain terms: stop pushing against the current. If you’ve been trying to force insights, explain everything, or organize your life into tidy boxes, this is your cue to pause. Let what you’ve learned sink in and focus on integration instead of trying to control the chaos, or push forward against it.

entries.text: That New Moon was a funeral: not tragic, but raw, inevitable, and necessary. It was the last Pisces New Moon before Neptune left the sign, your final chance to drop the illusions before Aries called for action. Which dream were you keeping on life support? What needed to end that you kept postponing, until life did the letting go for you?

Every Virgo transit since then has tested whether you actually integrated those lessons or just intellectualized them.

entries.text: The eclipse connects to important mathematical points in astrology called the lunar nodes, which are currently positioned at 18° Pisces and Virgo. These points show where eclipses happen and represent themes we're collectively working through. Jupiter made a harmonious connection to these points on September 3rd, which amplified the eclipse's impact and suggests the changes happening now will have lasting effects rather than being temporary disruptions.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The nodes represent a tension between two approaches: the North Node in Pisces encourages us to learn how to trust timing and flow, while the South Node in Virgo asks us to release the need to control every detail. This creates pressure to develop more Piscean qualities like compassion and acceptance while still maintaining practical responsibility.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Neptune, which traditionally rules Pisces, is at 29° Pisces - the very last degree of the sign. This is significant because Neptune hasn't changed signs in 14 years, and it's about to move into Aries. This placement adds urgency to the eclipse's message about completing emotional and spiritual lessons before moving into a more action-oriented phase.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Jupiter, Pisces' other ruler, is currently in Cancer at 18°, creating supportive energy that helps turn emotional insights into practical life changes. This means the intuitive understanding you gain during this eclipse period has a better chance of actually improving your daily circumstances rather than remaining abstract.

entries.text: The Virgo-Pisces Axis
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Precision meets surrender on the Virgo–Pisces line, but when the Moon is eclipsed in Pisces the conversation turns personal. The light cuts through fog. What was avoided asks to be felt. What was carried too long asks to be set down. Virgo still handles the edits and the systems. Pisces names the feeling and lets the tide move what logic cannot.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Both signs care about healing, integrity, and service. Both want wholeness. They simply travel different roads to reach it. Virgo teaches that reality changes through small repeatable actions. Edit one habit. Clean one corner. Keep one promise you can actually keep. Pisces teaches that life is larger than any plan. It opens imagination, compassion, and trust. Some moments ask for presence more than problem solving. Some questions do not want a spreadsheet. They want honesty and a softer jaw.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: During a Pisces eclipse, these truths get amplified. The Moon in Pisces is not asking for performance. It is asking for contact. With yourself, with what hurts, with what is ready to end. Virgo gives Pisces a container so tenderness does not flood the room. Pisces gives Virgo a heart so excellence does not turn into punishment. When they speak to each other, doing and being stop fighting and start collaborating.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: There are traps. On one side sits overcontrol. When fear gets loud, Virgo can tighten into micromanaging, endless edits, and criticism that crushes momentum. You try to fix everything so you do not have to feel anything. The project stalls. The body burns out. On the other side sits drift. When the world feels too sharp, Pisces can float into avoidance, martyr stories, and porous boundaries that let everything in. You wait for a sign and call it faith while your life waits for a decision. Confusion thickens. Commitments dissolve.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Both are strategies. Neither is freedom. Freedom lives between them, where discernment and trust meet. During this eclipse that balance sounds like this: I will tell the truth about how I feel, I will change one small thing that helps, and I will stop when enough is enough. That sentence can change a day. It can also change a year.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: What does that look like in practice, right now. Begin with the smallest bridge you can build. Choose one tiny edit that reduces friction in your daily life. Put your phone in another room for an hour. Preload tomorrow’s coffee. Set a two-line agenda before a meeting. Then create one honest boundary that protects recovery time. Block a half hour for a walk. Say no to a request that costs more than it gives. Finally, give yourself five minutes of presence. Breathe through the nose. Name the feeling on the inhale. Allow the feeling on the exhale. Then take one concrete action that supports your day.

entries.text: The two weeks between eclipses form what astrologers call the "corridor of fate" - a space where life accelerates and redirections occur. People may enter or exit your life. Systems may collapse or reset. Your job is to stay present and stop interfering.

entries.text: Week One: Clarity Through Chaos During the first week post-eclipse, Mercury's continued journey through Virgo provides analytical precision that cuts through Pisces' emotional fog. The superior conjunction between Mercury and the Sun on September 13th at 20° Virgo creates a moment when mental clarity illuminates the concrete steps needed to integrate eclipse insights. This is when overwhelming emotional awareness transforms into workable knowledge.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The pressure intensifies on September 11th when Mercury forms a sesquiquadrate to Pluto, forcing examination of the power dynamics hidden within perfectionist patterns. This challenging aspect reveals where control has been masquerading as care, pushing unconscious motivations into conscious awareness. Physical symptoms may correlate with emotional releases during this period.

entries.text: Week Two: Integration and Release The corridor's middle phase brings significant opportunities through Venus and Mars. On September 15th, Venus at 25° Leo forms a supportive sextile to Mars at 25° Libra, creating harmony between personal desires and relational action. People entering or leaving your life during this window often reflect the eclipse's deeper work around boundaries and authentic connection.

entries.text: The corridor's most significant tension arrives with Mercury's opposition to Saturn on September 17th at 28° Virgo-Pisces. This aspect reactivates the eclipse degrees with Virgo's demand for practical structure opposing Pisces' call for spiritual surrender. Systems that seemed stable may reveal their limitations, while new structures emerge that honor both efficiency and flow.

entries.text: Two important shifts shape the corridor's energy: Vesta's entrance into Sagittarius on September 13th redirects devotional energy toward broader meaning-making, often bringing dreams and synchronicities with themes of travel or teaching. Mercury's ingress into Libra on September 18th shifts mental focus from Virgo's analysis to Libra's synthesis.

entries.text: Big turning points often start as small daily choices. When life is in flux, the same theme shows up everywhere. A talk about boundaries at work, a dream about water, an urge to reorganize your home. That is your pattern talking. Follow it and let your outer life match what is true inside.

entries.text: Think of the Partial Solar Eclipse at 29° Virgo as the season’s closing ceremony and a release of the habit of controlling outcomes by overpreparing. At the final degree of Virgo, it points to mastery earned through real-life tests. Because it arrives just hours before the Autumn Equinox, treat it like a reset.

entries.text: On September 22, the Sun enters Libra and Mars enters Scorpio. The focus shifts to balance and emotional depth. This closing stretch runs through the Libra New Moon on October 21, helping you find your new equilibrium.

entries.text: This is the integration phase. Let the changes take root through simple, steady actions. Embody the lessons, don’t just think about them. Stop treating your emotions like errors to fix. Some truths are felt in your body, not listed on a page. Some chaos is information. Let it teach you.

entries.text: A lot of folks lost work, and the grief is real. The seeds planted in February are ready now. Some grew into wisdom you can carry forward. Some never rooted, and that is your cue to compost them. This eclipse helps you sort the two. Keep the skills, relationships, and habits that actually support you. Release the roles, stories, and routines that drain you.

entries.text: Aries & Aries Rising The eclipse hits your 12th house of hidden patterns and subconscious programming. You've been running on autopilot, reacting to triggers you don't fully understand. That anger that flares up seemingly out of nowhere? It's connected to something deeper that needs acknowledgment, not management. Your dreams may be more vivid during this period - pay attention to recurring themes. You're being asked to release patterns of self-sabotage that you inherited rather than chose. Stop pushing through exhaustion and start asking why you feel the need to prove yourself constantly. The part of you that needs to be first, best, fastest is protecting a wound that's ready to heal.

entries.text: Taurus & Taurus Rising The eclipse activates your 11th house of friendships and collective belonging. You're seeing clearly which relationships have been one-sided, which groups drain your energy, and where you've been performing a version of yourself to fit in. That friend who only calls when they need something? The social circle where you feel like you have to earn your place? Time to reevaluate. Your nervous system knows the difference between authentic community and transactional relationships. You don't have to stay loyal to connections that consistently leave you feeling depleted. Real belonging doesn't require you to shrink or overextend yourself.

entries.text: Gemini & Gemini Rising The eclipse illuminates your 10th house of career and public reputation. The professional persona you've been maintaining feels increasingly exhausting. You've been saying yes to opportunities that look good on paper but drain your soul. This eclipse reveals where your public image has become a prison that prevents authentic expression. The work that once felt meaningful may no longer align with who you're becoming. Trust the restlessness. Your mind is ready for challenges that engage your actual interests, not just your marketable skills. Stop performing competence in areas that bore you.

entries.text: Cancer & Cancer Rising The eclipse hits your 9th house of beliefs and higher learning. Everything you thought you knew about spirituality, education, or life philosophy is up for revision. That spiritual practice that felt profound six months ago might now feel empty. The beliefs you inherited from family or culture are being tested against your lived experience. You're outgrowing teachers, traditions, or ways of understanding the world that once provided comfort. This isn't about losing faith - it's about developing discernment. Your intuition is becoming more sophisticated than the frameworks you've been using to understand it.

entries.text: Leo & Leo Rising The eclipse activates your 8th house of shared resources and psychological depths. Financial arrangements that seemed stable are revealing their true cost. This could be literal money - debts, joint accounts, or business partnerships that need restructuring. But it's also about emotional exchanges where you've been giving more than you receive. You're becoming aware of power dynamics that were previously invisible. That relationship where you always pick up the check, do the emotional labor, or provide the energy while getting little back? Time to reassess the terms. Intimacy requires reciprocity.

entries.text: Virgo & Virgo Rising The eclipse hits your 7th house of partnerships and committed relationships. You're seeing your closest relationships with new clarity, and it might be uncomfortable. The person you've been accommodating, supporting, or trying to fix is showing you exactly who they are when you stop managing their experience. Your people-pleasing has been enabling behavior you wouldn't accept from a stranger. This eclipse asks whether you're in relationships where you can be yourself or where you have to perform being "easy to love." Real partnership supports your growth, not just your usefulness.

entries.text: Libra & Libra Rising The eclipse illuminates your 6th house of daily routines, work, and health. The systems you've created to manage your life are either supporting your wellbeing or slowly undermining it. Your body has been sending signals about what's not working - the job that gives you Sunday scaries, the routine that leaves you exhausted, the health habits that feel like punishment rather than care. You've been trying to optimize your way into feeling good, but optimization requires you to first admit what actually feels good versus what you think should feel good. Stop forcing yourself through routines that drain your life force.

entries.text: Scorpio & Scorpio Rising The eclipse activates your 5th house of creativity, romance, and authentic self-expression. You've been playing it safe with your creative output, your romantic choices, or how you express joy. The eclipse reveals where fear has been disguised as practicality. That creative project you keep postponing because it's "not commercial enough"? The person you're interested in but haven't approached because they're "not your type"? The hobby you abandoned because it seemed frivolous? This eclipse asks what would happen if you prioritized what brings you alive over what makes logical sense.
