entries.text: This Full Moon lands in your 9th house, highlighting the 9th/3rd house axis of beliefs versus daily communication. The gap between what you think and what you say becomes visible. The Mars-Uranus opposition on November 4th may have brought a conversation that shifted something, a sudden realization, or information that changed your thinking. This Full Moon illuminates where your words have become more careful than true. You might be noticing you've been editing your words to sound more certain than you feel, presenting your thoughts as fully formed conclusions when they're still questions. Uncertainty can feel like weakness, so you've been compensating with certainty. Your body knows when you're speaking truth versus performing certainty, you can feel it in your throat, the slight constriction when you edit yourself. This could be a week to experiment with sharing a thought that's still forming, saying something like "I'm still figuring this out, but here's where I am right now," or "I used to think X, but I'm questioning that." In work situations, there's often more power in admitting you're not sure yet than in manufacturing false certainty. People trust process more than they trust perfection. You might be ready to release the precision that's become armor, the need to have everything figured out before you speak. You might also notice your beliefs about how things "should" work are bumping up against how things work, showing you where rigidity might be creating unnecessary struggle. Even letting one belief become flexible ("Maybe there's not one right way to do this") can open up options you couldn't see before.

entries.text: This Full Moon lands in your 2nd house, highlighting the 2nd/8th house axis of personal income versus shared resources. Financial entanglements and worth issues come to a head. The Mars-Uranus opposition on November 4th probably disrupted a financial arrangement or power dynamic in a close partnership, maybe with a spouse, business partner, or intimate relationship. This Full Moon illuminates where peace-keeping has cost you financial clarity. You might be realizing that accommodating to keep the peace has cost you clarity about what you're worth. Conflict avoidance is a survival strategy that made sense for a long time. Your body might register this imbalance, the knot in your stomach when you accept less than fair terms, the way you brace yourself before financial conversations. This could be a moment to state a need without softening it first, not dramatically, but clearly. Something like, "I need us to split this differently," or "I'm not comfortable with this arrangement anymore," without the cushioning that usually comes before. If money is tangled with someone else, this might be when you get honest about what's fair versus what you've been accepting to avoid tension. Maybe it's time to let go of the pattern of negotiating your worth downward to keep relationships comfortable, the financial arrangements that only work if you stay quiet. Try writing down what you think the split should be before talking to them, so you're starting from your assessment rather than negotiating down from it. Even small acts of claiming worth, asking for the rate you want instead of what you think they'll accept, can shift the pattern. Your value isn't up for negotiation, even in relationships where you love the other person.

entries.text: This Full Moon lands in your 7th house, highlighting the 7th/1st house axis of partnership versus self. Your relational dynamics are at maximum visibility. The Mars-Uranus opposition on November 4th may have brought sudden tension or breakthrough in a partnership. This Full Moon reveals where you've been carrying all the emotional intensity while others stay surface-level. You might be noticing you've been carrying all the emotional intensity in relationships while the other person gets to stay surface-level, and the resentment about that is getting harder to ignore. You've been accepting "shallow" as if it's the same as "safe." Your body might be holding this frustration, the tightness of unexpressed needs, the exhaustion of always being the one who goes deep. This could be a week to ask for what you want in terms of intimacy and depth. Something like, "I need us to talk about the real things, not just logistics," or "I need to know what you're feeling about this." Not everyone earned access to all of you, that's true and important. And also, the people who are your people, they can handle your intensity, your questions, your need to go deeper. You might be ready to release the belief that your depth is too much, the pattern of testing rather than asking directly. The work might be distinguishing between protecting yourself from people who can't meet you, and protecting yourself from intimacy entirely. Even your closest relationships might benefit from you being more direct about what you need instead of just holding intensity about what they need. Try naming what you want clearly instead of testing whether they'll intuit it.

entries.text: This Full Moon lands in your 6th house, highlighting the 6th/12th house axis of daily work versus rest. Your exhaustion and work patterns reach a breaking point. The Mars-Uranus opposition on November 4th probably disrupted your rest, solitude, or the behind-the-scenes processing time you need. If job loss or work instability is part of what's happening, the anxiety about money makes rest almost impossible. This Full Moon illuminates the cost of running on stress hormones and calling it productivity. You might be noticing you've been running on stress hormones for months or even years, using busyness and productivity to avoid feeling the harder emotions underneath. This has been a survival strategy, and it's reached its limit. Your body is giving you clear information about what's sustainable, you can feel it in the quality of your exhaustion, the way even sleep doesn't restore you. As you navigate rebuilding work, this might be a moment to build differently from the start. What if rest wasn't the reward for finishing everything, but the foundation that helps you make better decisions about what to take on? Maybe this is your invitation to release treating rest as something earned, the busyness that protects you from feeling. Even small practices, mornings without immediately checking your phone, one day a week with no productivity goals, can help you distinguish between what's sustainable and what's just another version of survival mode. Your body has been trying to tell you something about pace and capacity, sometimes the work is learning to listen before you're completely depleted.

entries.text: This Full Moon lands in your 5th house, highlighting the 5th/11th house axis of creative self-expression versus community. Where joy has become work and authenticity has become performance becomes visible. The Mars-Uranus opposition on November 4th may have disrupted a friendship dynamic or community space you've been part of. This Full Moon shows you where you've been treating creativity like productivity and friendships like roles. You might be noticing you've been treating your creative work like a job, making sure every project demonstrates value or serves some function. Joy without purpose can feel indulgent or wasteful. Your body knows the difference between joy and productive joy, you can feel it in how you hold yourself when creating for approval versus creating for pleasure. This could be a week to experiment with creating something that serves no purpose except that it feels good, making art no one will see, cooking an elaborate meal just for yourself. In your communities and friendships, you might notice you've been showing up as a role (the responsible one, the organizer, the problem-solver) rather than as yourself. Maybe this Full Moon is asking you to let go of the need for your joy to justify itself, the version of yourself you perform in groups. Try showing up to one social thing as just you, not in your usual function. Share an opinion that doesn't fit your brand, admit you don't want to help with something. The people who want you unedited, they're your real community.

entries.text: This Full Moon lands in your 4th house, highlighting the 4th/10th house axis of home versus career. The foundation you've been building reaches a crisis point. With the Mars-Uranus opposition on November 4th involving your ruling planet, this transit is especially significant for you. If you lost a job, major project, or professional opportunity, that's a real crisis with real consequences. You have bills, responsibilities, people depending on you. This Full Moon illuminates where one part of your life has been sacrificed for the other. This disruption might be showing you where you've been building on a foundation that wasn't sustainable. A role that required you to be someone you're not, a company culture that felt suffocating, or work that paid the bills but slowly drained your capacity to think clearly. Your body might be registering this split, the exhaustion of code-switching, the tension of maintaining different versions of yourself for home versus work. As you handle the immediate work of finding income, you might keep one eye on what sustainable looks like for you. Maybe that's work with more autonomy, a role that lets you be unconventional, a company that values the way your brain works differently. This might be your moment to release the career built on being someone you're not, the domestic situation that no longer supports who you're becoming. Your home life might need to shift to support whatever's emerging, downsizing to reduce pressure, moving somewhere cheaper to buy time, or having honest conversations with family about what you're navigating.

entries.text: This Full Moon lands in your 3rd house, highlighting the 3rd/9th house axis of immediate environment versus beliefs. The gap between borrowed wisdom and your own knowing becomes visible. The Mars-Uranus opposition on November 4th likely disrupted a long-distance connection, educational path, or belief system you've been operating from. This Full Moon reveals where you've been using other people's frameworks to avoid your own questions. You might be noticing there's a gap between the spiritual understanding you've adopted and what you think or feel. It's been easier to borrow someone else's wisdom than to sit with your own uncertainty. Your body knows when you're speaking borrowed truth versus your own, there's a different sensation, the difference between words that flow and words that feel rehearsed. This could be a week to say what you think in daily conversations, even if it's not fully formed or doesn't sound enlightened. Something like, "I used to believe that, but I'm not sure anymore," or "That wisdom doesn't resonate with me." Maybe you're ready to let go of the spiritual bypassing that sounds enlightened but feels hollow, the wisdom adopted because it seemed right rather than because it resonates. Your local relationships, the people you see regularly and talk to about daily life, they might deepen when you bring them your real thoughts instead of your spiritual performance. You might also notice your immediate environment needs more of your honest presence and less of your mystical interpretation. Sometimes the work is just being here, in the moment, with what is.

entries.text: This Gemini New Moon charges the air with intention. As the moon’s light begins to build, so does your ability to call something into being. This is the moment to plant seeds through conversation, through writing, through truth-telling. To open the door that only dialogue can unlock. To say what needs to be said.

entries.text: Gemini's trickster Twins also remind you to approach life with playfulness, curiosity, and childlike wonder, considering the heaviness of merging polar forces, a little lightness is needed. But left unchecked, Gemini’s gift for exploration can turn chaotic. Without grounding, curiosity becomes avoidance. Words become noise. It is important that when embodying his passion for information, learning, and communicating, you prioritize self-awareness of how your actions and choices impact others.

You're being asked to trust information that doesn't come through traditional channels. Your intuition and discernment becomes your compass.

entries.text: This Gemini Season belongs to those who refuse to be manipulated by language. Those who remember that distraction is a strategy of control. Those who are learning that systems collapse when we stop telling and sharing false narratives.

entries.text: Gemini is ruled by Mercury, and Mercury is ruled by curiosity. But when Mercury’s mouth is full of power, it isn’t just curious. It’s dangerous. This is where you speak a new reality into being. You decide what story gets to live.

entries.text: The Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter are all in Gemini. This lunation is crowded, restless. The Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter are all sitting in the same room, all talking at once. That’s a lot of thoughts, a lot of noise, a lot of potential. This New Moon wants you to see how your reality has been shaped by the words you were taught to use, and the ones you weren’t allowed to say. Mercury, ruler of Gemini, is very close to this New Moon. Gemini isn’t just about talking, it’s about thinking differently. Asking harder questions. Getting curious about your beliefs, your habits, your assumptions. Why do you believe what you believe? Who taught you that? And is it still true?

This New Moon hits your second house, and the question is what you trade away to feel secure. Mercury and Jupiter are rewriting the fine print of your internal economy. Where have you been underpaid, overlooked, or overextended? Stop calling it stability if it’s costing you yourself.

Let your presence be a reminder that we’re all in this together. In the months ahead, you’ll be asked to show up in your communities in a way that honors your energy.

You’re discovering more and more about yourself on a daily basis and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your career. Sudden shifts in status, responsibility, or direction may feel disorienting, but they’re pushing you into alignment. Even if the path ahead isn’t fully clear, zoom out. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, it aligns with your values and is building toward your future.

The wisdom you’re after won’t come through logic alone, it shows up in the strange timing, the dream you can’t shake, the moment that stops you mid-thought.

The New Moon moves through your eighth house of intimacy, loss, and shared power. Mercury and Jupiter bring language to what’s been unspeakable.

Your natural ability to dive deep into the underworld/unknown will help you navigate through any uncertainty or darkness. What you thought gave you security may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges.

entries.text: Are you abandoning a part of yourself to receive love and validation? You’re questioning if you show up fully as yourself and how this impacts your life. The new moon is a reminder not to abandon yourself or get stuck in rebellious pride or ego.

entries.text: Saturn in Aries moves through your third house. The way you speak and think is being rewritten. Over the next six months, you're being asked to choose substance over performance. Say what you mean. Say it like it matters. Because it does.

entries.text: If you’ve been questioning what safety feels like, what home means, or what legacy you’re building, this is why. The New Moon lights up your fourth house of roots, ancestry, and belonging. Mercury and Jupiter are helping you name the truths that live in your foundation.

entries.text: You could be seeing some changes to your home and family situation or re-assessing what provides comfort and security. You may also be thinking about moving and exploring the various contradictions and conflicts within yourself around what you need to feel happy and stable. Let this be an exploration, not a crisis.

entries.text: Saturn in Aries brings focus to your second house, money, stability, and self-worth. Over the next six months, you’ll make decisions that redefine what it means to feel secure. Let your voice rebuild what silence once protected.

entries.text: Sun is in Gemini from May 20-June 20, 2025
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Gemini Season begins on May 20, inviting a shift toward movement, conversation, learning, and conscious curiosity. This is a time to notice what you’re saying, what you avoid, and why. Words are choices that reveal alignment or avoidance. With Mercury in its home sign and Saturn newly in Aries, every thought becomes a test of honesty.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Mercury returns to Gemini on May 25th, yet Saturn's recent entrance into Aries three days prior changes everything. Words carry consequence. This is not a gentle Gemini season. The usual lightness is gone. It doesn’t hold your hand. It sharpens the mind, splits the tongue, teaches you how to say what you mean and mean what you say. But clarity isn’t the end goal. Responsibility is.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Saturn in Aries (Saturn in Aries) doesn't let Mercury play its usual tricks. From the moment Mercury touches Saturn on May 25th (their first sextile at 0 degrees), every exchange becomes a test. What are you willing to commit to saying? What truths are you prepared to defend?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The New Moon in Gemini on May 26th arrives just hours after Mercury sextiles Neptune in Aries. Dreams bleed into data. Intuition interrupts analysis. You're being asked to trust information that doesn't come through traditional channels. Your intuition and discernment becomes your compass.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The easy thing would be to tell you this is just about better communication or clearer thinking. But with Saturn breathing down Mercury's neck, we're talking about the responsibility of carrying messages that matter in a world drowning in noise.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This Gemini Season belongs to those who refuse to be manipulated by language. Those who remember that distraction is a strategy of control. Those who are learning that systems collapse when we stop telling and sharing false narratives.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Gemini is ruled by Mercury, and Mercury is ruled by curiosity. But when Mercury’s mouth is full of power, it isn’t just curious. It’s dangerous. This is where you speak a new reality into being. You decide what story gets to live.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: On May 27th, Mercury forms a flowing trine to Pluto in Aquarius. This is where the real work begins. Words cut through collective delusions. Language exposes power. You're being initiated into a kind of dialogue that names what systems prefer to keep hidden.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Pluto in Aquarius has been exposing the rot in our networks, how we connect, how we communicate. When Mercury trines this energy, you’re not just observing it. You’re decoding it. You can see what others miss. You can name what others fear to speak. But here's the thing about Plutonian insight... once you see it, you can't unsee it. Once you speak it, it shakes the room.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: May 30th brings the moment we've been building toward: the Sun conjuncts Mercury at 9 degrees Gemini. This is not just the heart of Gemini season, it's the heart of a new way of thinking. When your core identity aligns with your mental processes, there's no separation between who you are and what you say. This conjunction happens while Saturn continues to apply pressure from Aries. Your words must match your actions.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The friction begins on June 5th when Mercury squares the North Node in Pisces. Your rational mind conflicts with your soul's direction. The information you've gathered, the conclusions you've drawn, they may not be leading you where you need to go.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Pisces reminds us that not everything can be thought through. Some paths require feeling, intuition, surrender to the unknown. When Mercury squares this energy, you're forced to choose between what makes intellectual sense and what just feels right.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The sextile to Chiron that follows on June 6th offers a healing: conversations that acknowledge wounds without picking at them. Words that bridge divides rather than deepening them. This is where Gemini season's true gift reveals itself, the ability to hold multiple truths without collapse.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Mercury's journey through Gemini culminates on June 8th with a conjunction to Jupiter at the critical 29th degree. This is information becoming wisdom. Data transforming into understanding. Everything you've learned, questioned, discussed, and processed during these two weeks crystallizes into something you can actually use.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: As Mercury immediately enters Cancer and Jupiter follows the next day, the focus shifts. The thinking phase ends. The feeling phase begins. But what you've gathered during these Gemini weeks will inform every emotional choice that follows.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: We're living through the collapse of information systems that once provided stability. Media literacy isn't enough anymore when the boundary between authentic and artificial keeps shifting. Social networks that promised connection deliver isolation. Search engines that promised knowledge deliver manipulation.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Gemini Season 2025 demands more than curiosity. It asks you to become your own filter. To stop letting others think for you. To trust your ability to know what’s real. Saturn in Aries isn’t interested in neutrality. It won’t let you hide behind “I’m just asking questions.” It wants you to take a position. To defend a truth. To say what you mean, and mean it enough to be held accountable.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This is hard work. It would be easier to scroll through everything, react to nothing, maintain the illusion that staying informed equals staying engaged. But deep down you've already decided.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You're under a pressure system that most can't see. Saturn has entered your sign while Mercury activates your third house of communication, making every conversation an opportunity to establish your authority. You're being asked to completely restructure how you think and speak about yourself.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The movement, messages, mental loops that Gemini season brings won't all be helpful. You're learning how to discern signal from noise. How to tell the truth before it's fully formed. The New Moon on May 26th gives you a fresh start with how you communicate in your daily life, with siblings, neighbors, in your immediate community.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Stop minimizing what you know. The insights coming through you aren't random thoughts, they're assignments. You don't have to explain yourself to everyone, but you do need to understand your own reasoning. Pay attention to what you learn during short trips, casual conversations, or while handling daily errands. Your local environment holds keys to bigger questions.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Sagittarius Full Moon on June 11th illuminates the tension between your everyday communication and your long-term philosophical beliefs. Get serious about your boundaries. Especially the ones you've been avoiding. This lunar event forces you to examine whether your daily conversations align with your evolving worldview.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This period asks you to speak with intention. Your words carry more weight than usual, especially with Saturn demanding authenticity in everything you say. Use this influence to establish yourself as someone worth listening to.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You're on the edge of something internal. Mercury lights up your second house, stirring questions of worth, value, voice. But the roots of these questions are older. Saturn drags them into the underworld of your chart.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You may feel blocked. Unclear. Uncertain about whether anything you're building will last. That's not failure. It's the beginning of alignment. This is about developing language for your worth that goes beyond what others have told you to value.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Gemini season wants your attention on what you've been investing in, energetically, emotionally, financially. Pull your power back from anything that's been draining it. The New Moon on May 26th offers a restart around how you communicate your value. You're learning to speak about what you offer in ways that reflect your authentic worth rather than market expectations.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Trust the practical wisdom you've accumulated through lived experience. Your grounded perspective is needed in spaces dominated by theory without substance. When Mercury sextiles Venus on June 6th, the connection between what you feel and what you think becomes clearer.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Sagittarius Full Moon on June 11th in your eighth house brings culmination around shared resources. A decision about joint finances, inheritance, or partnership assets reaches a turning point. This moment clarifies what you absolutely will not compromise on.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: There is no going back. You're in it now. Mercury returns to your sign and sets off a cascade of choices, conversations, opportunities, distractions. The old version of you would have said yes to everything. The newer version knows better.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This is your season, but it feels different than usual. Mercury moves through your first house while Saturn applies pressure from Aries, asking you to commit to ideas that serve your growth rather than just entertaining your curious mind.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Saturn asks: Who are you becoming when no one is watching? Gemini season invites reinvention, but the reinvention has to come with consequences. If it's all performance, you'll burn out fast. The New Moon on May 26th in your first house is deeply personal, you're integrating the mental and physical aspects of who you are.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Anchor your growth in integrity. Then move. You're being asked to choose which thoughts and interests deserve your sustained attention. Your natural multiplicity is valuable, but Saturn demands that you focus your mental energy on what actually supports your evolution.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Sagittarius Full Moon on June 11th in your seventh house creates culmination around how your communication style affects your partnerships. The tension between your need for intellectual freedom and your commitments to others requires honest conversation and maybe some renegotiation of agreements.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: This is a season of internal disruption. Most of what's changing can't be seen. But it can be felt. In your body. In your sleep. In your sense of safety. Mercury moves through your twelfth house, revealing thoughts you've buried, truths you weren't ready to name.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Your intuition is being upgraded to process information faster than your rational mind can track. Trust what flows through you during quiet moments. The New Moon on May 26th initiates a clearing of mental patterns that no longer serve your emerging identity.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Saturn brings pressure to your public self, how you lead, how you are seen. The dissonance between your inner life and your outer role is the tension point. Stop pretending they don't affect each other. You're allowed to change your direction.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Pay attention to insights that come through dreams, meditation, or solitude. The information you need right now exists in the spaces between your thoughts. As Mercury moves into your first house on June 8th, you'll start integrating these subtle understandings into your conscious identity.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Sagittarius Full Moon on June 11th in your sixth house illuminates how your daily routines support your emotional wellbeing. A work situation or health matter reaches a crescendo that forces you to prioritize your actual needs over what others expect from you.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You're thinking about the future in new ways. Not the fantasy of it, the infrastructure. Mercury enters your eleventh house with questions about vision, purpose, people. You're being asked to examine which connections support your creative vision and which ones drain your energy.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: But the real work is in your ninth: What do you believe is possible? What are you still loyal to that no longer deserves your commitment? Saturn wants integrity in your worldview. Gemini season brings the temptation to distract yourself with momentum.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Don't just join movements. Understand them. Find your place in them without losing yourself. The New Moon on May 26th plants seeds for new alliances with people who share your commitment to creative authenticity. You're finding your tribe not through surface similarities but through shared willingness to be vulnerable and real.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Your creative ideas have practical applications when shared with the right community. Mercury's sextile to Mars on June 5th activates your voice within group settings, but you're learning to be selective about which audiences receive your full creative expression.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Sagittarius Full Moon on June 11th in your fifth house creates tension between what groups expect from you and what you need to express individually. A friendship may be tested when your personal creative needs conflict with collective expectations.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You can't keep performing competence to systems that would rather use you than support you. Gemini season lights up your tenth house of career, reputation, visibility. Mercury is there, your ruler, full of insight and exhaustion.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You're expected to explain yourself constantly. But Saturn in your eighth is pulling the curtain back on power, asking where you're still pretending to be okay so others don't feel discomfort. If you want real success, it has to include honesty.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Say what you need. Let the mask fall. The New Moon on May 26th seeds professional developments that could shape your reputation for years to come. This is about establishing yourself as a reliable voice in your field through consistent, clear communication.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Your ability to synthesize complex information into practical insights is your professional superpower. Focus on communication systems that serve long-term sustainability rather than quick fixes. The details matter, but not all equally, practice discernment.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Sagittarius Full Moon on June 11th in your fourth house forces decisions about work-life balance. Career demands and family needs reach a point where you must choose your priorities clearly. You cannot serve everything with equal devotion.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You're not here to stay balanced. You're here to engage. Gemini season invites expansion, new ideas, new teachings, new belief systems. But none of that will matter unless you also confront what's happening in your relationships.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Mercury activates your ninth house of learning and philosophy. You're being challenged to develop your own framework for understanding the world rather than borrowing from others' systems. Saturn brings accountability to your partnerships. Not punishment. Structure.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: You're being asked to match your words with your actions, your values with your commitments. Stop waiting for others to get on board. Choose what's aligned. And be willing to walk away from what isn't.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The New Moon on May 26th initiates a new learning cycle. This could manifest as formal education, travel planning, or beginning a teaching or writing project. Your natural ability to see multiple perspectives is valuable, but Saturn's pressure demands you eventually choose where you stand.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Sagittarius Full Moon on June 11th in your third house brings your expanded worldview into daily conversation. You're translating higher learning into practical communication. A conversation with someone close reflects your philosophical growth.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The truth doesn't need to be dramatic to change everything. Gemini season works on you quietly. Mercury highlights your eighth house, where secrets and inheritances live. Emotional debts may resurface. Shared resources. Trust. Control.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The trine to Pluto on May 27th enhances your ability to see what others miss, the hidden dynamics, unspoken motivations, and power structures in every situation. Saturn shows up in your sixth house and demands that you stop sacrificing your health for other people's comfort.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The Leo-Aquarius axis is a battlefield between the sovereign and the revolutionary, the star and the collective, the performer and the visionary. At its core, this polarity is about the tension between self-expression and group consciousness, individuality and progress.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Leo, ruled by the Sun, demands to be seen, to shine, to radiate from the center. It thrives on validation, personal creativity, and a sense of significance. Aquarius, governed by Saturn and Uranus, rejects the need for approval, dismantling hierarchies and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. It is uninterested in performance for performance’s sake, its focus is the greater good, the future, the collective dream.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: But these signs are not enemies. They are each other’s missing piece. Leo gives Aquarius permission to be human. To revel in the joy of creation. To feel, to play, to express without the need for logic or justification. Without Leo, Aquarius risks becoming a detached intellect, a thinker without a heartbeat. Aquarius gives Leo perspective. It reminds the Sun-ruled that their light is not just for themselves, it can be a beacon, a force for change. It pulls Leo out of self-obsession and into the realm of innovation, reminding them that true power isn’t about dominance, it’s about influence.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Together, they teach that validation and rebellion are not opposites, but forces that can feed each other. Leo must learn to take risks, even when no one is watching. Aquarius must learn that rebellion without purpose is empty.

entries.text: This lunation is not gentle. The Moon stands in opposition to Mercury in Aquarius, pressing language against feeling, intellect against instinct. Square to Uranus in Taurus, the tension is electric. A breaking point. A rupture. The old patterns can’t hold. Something snaps, and in the silence that follows, you can hear the truth.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Uranus stationed direct Jan 30th, and now it squares the Sun. This happens every time Uranus moves forward, but this year, the square is magnified by the Full Moon in Leo. Leo’s fire ignites by Uranus’s disruption. Uranus is the focal point of this T-square, the earthquake beneath our feet. When the Moon, the Sun, and Mercury all challenge Uranus, disruption is inevitable. Whether it arrives as a revelation, a confrontation, or a sudden break in the script, it forces clarity. The past few weeks may have felt like limbo, decisions suspended in midair. No more. What shatters now was never stable to begin with. Uranian lunations often bring the changes that have been long overdue, unsettling at first, but ultimately necessary. The challenge with Uranus is its unpredictability. What unfolds now may not be what you expected, but that doesn’t mean it isn’t exactly what is needed.

entries.text: If you are in rhythm with Uranus, you are the one lighting the match. You are the force of disruption, tearing down what no longer holds, scattering the old world like ash, seeding something new in its place. You become the change you want to see in the world.

entries.text: But if you have been clinging to certainty, if you have built your life around the illusion of stability, Uranus does not ask permission. It moves like a shockwave, ripping away the illusion of safety, shoving you out of the nest before you are ready to fly. The job you thought was secure - gone. The home you thought would hold you - no longer yours and suddenly unlivable. The money you were counting on disappears. The secrets you feared would surface - exposed under an unrelenting sky. The future you assumed was waiting for you is no longer an option.

entries.text: Uranus exposes where you have been asleep, where you have mistaken routine for permanence. This is the nature of Uranus. It does not destroy to punish. It destroys to liberate. Whether you surrender to the current or fight against it, everything unstable will come undone. The question is not if change is coming. The question is whether you will meet it willingly, or be dragged into it kicking and screaming.

entries.text: (You should know, I hated writing this last few paragraphs. But here we are. And maybe you hate reading it too, because you already know where it’s going. And trust me, I get it. I could wrap this up in something softer, tell you that change is a gift, that everything happens for a reason. But let’s be honest, Uranus doesn’t care how you feel about it.)

entries.text: This Full Moon brings an active Mars-Chiron square (90º). Mars, still retrograde in Cancer, is exalted, stationing as it prepares to move direct on February 23rd. Retrograde Mars in Cancer locks into a harsh square with Chiron in Aries. This is raw, emotional pain. A deep, ancestral wound. Mars in Cancer fights from the past. It protects, it defends, but it also clings. When Mars clashes with Chiron, we lash out from old insecurities, from places where we were not seen, not valued, not protected. The Full Moon’s light makes it impossible to look away. Where does the pain live in your body? Where does the anger go when it has nowhere to land? This square is reactive. The way through is acknowledgment, not avoidance.

entries.text: Leo (Moon) and Aries (Chiron) are both fire signs, and this trine is a call to courage. If Uranus is shaking loose the old story, Chiron is showing you how to move through it without repeating the past. The wound is open, but so is the door. If you listen closely, there is wisdom here. It’s making the choice, over and over, to move differently than before. This Full Moon doesn’t just reveal the wound. It presses into it, forcing you to feel it fully. But in that pressure, lies the medicine.

entries.text: This Full Moon is a breaking point. The Leo-Aquarius axis forces a confrontation between the personal and the collective, the heart and the mind, the self and the system. The Moon’s opposition to Mercury in Aquarius stirs miscommunication, resistance, and the fight between logic and feeling. The T-square with Uranus in Taurus is disruptive, what is stable will not remain so. Yet the trine to Chiron in Aries offers a way forward. If you can name the wound, you can begin to heal it.

entries.text: (Leo Full Moon in your 5th house, Uranus in your 2nd) What are you afraid of? Not failure, failure has never scared you. What you fear is stillness. The moment when there is nothing left to chase, nothing left to prove. The Full Moon lights up your hunger, but hunger without direction is chaos. You must decide: are you running toward something, or just running?

entries.text: The fire inside you is restless. The Leo Full Moon ignites your 5th house of creation, desire, expression. A flame that refuses to be dimmed. But Mars in Cancer, retrograde and exalted, squares Chiron in Aries. You feel it in your body, a wound still raw, an old fear still gripping.

entries.text: Uranus in your 2nd house of worth sends tremors through the structures you rely on. Money. Stability. Self-esteem. The things you’ve built may not be as solid as they seemed.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: But the Moon trines Chiron, a reminder: The wound is not the enemy. Fear is not the enemy. Silence is. With Mars still retrograde in Cancer, home and family wounds resurface. The feeling of fighting battles alone, the anger that comes from not being fully seen. You don’t have to keep playing the same role. The world will not collapse if you rewrite the script.

entries.text: You have always craved certainty, the comfort of the known. But certainty has never been real, and the Leo Full Moon forces you to confront that. The walls around you are trembling. The Leo Full Moon presses against your 4th house of home, belonging, foundation. Uranus in your sign makes this deeply personal. Uranus chaotic and demands change.

entries.text: Mercury is shifting, and so are you. You can feel it in your bones, in the way language is starting to fail you. This Full Moon does not need you to explain yourself. It needs you to feel. To sit with the discomfort of not knowing. The air is thick with static. The Leo Full Moon electrifies your 3rd house of speech, thought, perception. The unspoken weighs heavy.

entries.text: There is something you have not said. A truth that lives in your throat, restless and sharp. The Leo Full Moon forces it forward, ready or not. Uranus in Taurus stirs something deep within, pulling at subconscious threads you haven’t fully unraveled. The opposition to Mercury in Aquarius pushes logic against feeling. What is real? What is distortion? Not everything that sounds good is true.

entries.text: (Leo Full Moon in your 2nd house, Uranus in your 11th) Mars is pressing against your ribs, demanding action. The Full Moon sets fire to the part of you that has been waiting, hesitating, convincing yourself that "someday" is a real place. There is no someday. There is only now.

entries.text: There is no such thing as emotional safety. Not now. The Leo Full Moon exposes your 2nd house, money, security, self-worth. Where you have over-given. Where you have accepted too little.

entries.text: Mars, still retrograde in your sign, is fighting old battles. The ones you said you were done with, but never really left behind. The square to Chiron in Aries pulls at the core wound: Did I do enough? Did I matter?

entries.text: This is your moment. But don’t mistake the spotlight for salvation. The Full Moon strips you bare, forces you to see yourself without the armor of attention. Who are you, when the applause fades, when the room empties? There is no hiding. Not from yourself, not from the world. The Leo Full Moon floods your 1st house of identity, self-image, presence.

entries.text: You have shaped yourself in the eyes of others. You have played the part, given them what they needed. Now, the mask fractures. Mercury in Aquarius, opposite the Moon, challenges your self-perception. Uranus in Taurus shakes your public life. An old version of you is breaking away. A relationship reaches a turning point. A breakup, an ultimatum, or a defining conversation pushes things forward, or ends them.

entries.text: (Leo Full Moon in your 12th house, Uranus in your 9th) The Leo Full Moon illuminates your 12th house of the unseen, the subconscious, the unfinished. What rises now is not new. A memory. A regret. A moment you thought was over. Uranus in Taurus forces a change in belief, perspective, understanding. The opposition to Mercury in Aquarius stirs confusion. Are you making sense of the past, or rewriting it?

entries.text: (Leo Full Moon in your 11th house, Uranus in your 8th) The Leo Full Moon ignites your 11th house of friendships, the future, the dream. Something in your vision shifts. What you thought you wanted may no longer fit. Uranus in Taurus shakes your 8th house of entanglements, dependencies, control. The terms of an agreement are changing. The opposition to Mercury in Aquarius stirs tension in creative expression, in how you connect to joy. Chiron in Aries is still there, an old wound in relationships: the fear of being chosen, the fear of being abandoned. The Moon trines Chiron, showing you that healing does not come from waiting. It comes from stepping forward.

entries.text: Something shifts in your 10th house of career, reputation, and legacy. The structures you’ve built, the roles you’ve played, the identity you’ve carefully cultivated—all of it is under cosmic review. Not because you planned for it. Not because you were ready. But because Uranus in your 7th house of partnerships is shaking the ground beneath you, whether you asked for it or not.

entries.text: The way you move through the world is changing. The way you are seen is changing. You were the protector. The strategist. The one who saw five moves ahead and played accordingly. But the game has changed, and the old playbook is useless. What once kept you in control now keeps you trapped.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Mercury in Aquarius dissects the past, pulling at the seams of your origin story. The version of home you’ve carried in your bones, even when you left it behind. There is a choice ahead, one you’ve been avoiding. A step into something unfamiliar. A release of something that was never truly yours.

entries.text: Mars retrograde in your 9th house of belief systems exposes where you’ve been holding on to an outdated framework. Where have you mistaken old wisdom for truth? Where have you convinced yourself that growth means staying put? What’s shifting now is not negotiable. You don’t have to know exactly where you’re going. You just have to stop gripping onto where you’ve been.

entries.text: (Leo Full Moon in your 9th house, Uranus in your 6th) The Leo Full Moon ignites your 9th house of expansion, wisdom, and higher vision. Something is being revealed—maybe a long-held dream, an urge to break free, or a truth you can no longer ignore. This lunation is a call to adventure, a moment where your beliefs and worldview are tested. A shift is coming. Where have you outgrown the story you've been telling yourself?

entries.text: Meanwhile, Uranus in Taurus sends tremors through your 6th house of work, health, and daily routines. Your sense of stability is shifting—maybe your job no longer fits, your body demands new care, or your schedule refuses to stay predictable. What systems in your life need restructuring?

entries.text: (Leo Full Moon in your 8th house, Uranus in your 5th) The Leo Full Moon ignites your 8th house - death and rebirth, power and surrender, the unseen contracts that shape your life. A cycle is closing. You cannot control what happens next, and yet, part of you is still clenching, still gripping onto what was. What are you afraid to release? Uranus in Taurus shakes the ground beneath your feet, unsettling your 5th house of creativity, love, and risk. Have you been holding back? Denying yourself joy? The opposition to Mercury in Aquarius forces you to reconcile what you believe you need versus what you actually crave.

entries.text: (Leo Full Moon in your 7th house, Uranus in your 4th) The Leo Full Moon blazes through your 7th house - partnerships, commitments, the way you see yourself through the eyes of another. Who have you become in your relationships? Have you stretched yourself to fit another’s expectations? Have you given too much, or not enough? The opposition to Mercury in your sign forces you to confront the difference between who you are and who others believe you to be. Uranus in Taurus crashes through your 4th house of home, security, the past. Something is shifting. A break in family dynamics. A change in where (or how) you belong. Mars in Cancer squares Chiron in Aries, the wound of self-sufficiency. The belief that if you don’t handle it yourself, no one will. But the Moon trines Chiron, offering a different truth: you do not have to hold it all alone.

entries.text: And then there’s your Solar Return. A Solar Return signals a new cycle, but when a Full Moon rises within it, the past demands closure before the future can begin. Something must be released. A chapter that has run its course. Something in your life is reaching its natural end. A version of yourself that no longer fits. Endings are not interruptions, they are initiations. You do not need permission to be yourself.

entries.text: New Moons are about new beginnings, a time to bring your intentions into focus and send them out into the Universe with a clear vision and actionable goals for manifestation. Leo the Lion. King of the pride, bold, beautiful, heartful, loving, generous, and playful; embodies the qualities we’re invited to access during this New Moon. At the same time, we need to watch for ego conflicts, unnecessary drama, entitlement, and selfishness. These patterns can easily surface and create tension in our relationships if we’re not paying attention. Leo asks us to embrace love in every area of our lives, and to recognize the essence of love that exists within ourselves.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Leo is the Divine Source of Creation made manifest in physical form, in each one of us. This lunation helps us access that inner fire more easily, inviting us to experience love in a new way. Cancer season reminded us that our feelings and needs are valid, and that communicating them in safe, nurturing spaces is a vital part of healing. During this Leo New Moon, reflect on who sees you, loves you, and accepts you as you are. When we feel safe in our bodies and environments, no longer hijacked by fight, flight, or freeze responses, our creativity opens. We can relax, connect with others from a calm and curious place, and express ourselves without fear of ridicule or rejection.

entries.text: As we transition from Cancer to Leo season, a new self begins to take shape, one rooted in safety, and revealed through joy. We’re not escaping our vulnerability; we’re creating from it. The higher expression of this Leo New Moon brings insight into emotional triggers, healing of old traumas, and a shift in how we view our worth. What’s arising now can be used as fuel for creative works and personal growth. And for some, it may be the reverse, creative projects may feel blocked, unseen, or under appreciated. If frustration is rising, notice the part of you that’s seeking recognition. Can you offer it to yourself with love and kindness? Can you allow that part of you to feel what it feels. Without judgment or pressure to “fix” it? This energy supports you in moving beyond the need for validation and stepping fully into your unapologetic self.

entries.text: Leo is ruled by the Sun, symbolizing consciousness, identity, and the essence of self. So when the Moon meets the Sun here, as it does during this New Moon, it marks a powerful moment of self-renewal. A return to who you are beneath the roles, the expectations, and the noise.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The New Moon is exactly opposite Pluto retrograde in Aquarius, challenging you to face the version of yourself you’ve had to become just to get by. It may bring up questions about the systems you've operated in: work, family, culture and how those environments shaped or silenced parts of you. It’s about seeing the layers you’ve shed to be accepted, and deciding which ones you’re ready to reclaim. Think of it as shadow work done in broad daylight: nothing hidden, nothing off-limits, just the truth staring back at you.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Mercury retrograde, exalted in Leo, conjuncts the New Moon (though not exact). You’re being asked to rewrite the story of who you think you are. And how you narrate this story. If you’ve recently lost your job, your title, your creative momentum, or the version of yourself you built your identity around, this New Moon doesn’t bypass that grief. It does ask, what’s left? That’s what you rebuild from.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: At the same time, the Venus-Mars square puts tension on relationships and values. Mars is tightly aligned with the South Node in Virgo, highlighting old patterns of service, burnout, or self-sacrifice. If you’ve been trying to earn love through perfection or martyrdom, this lunation calls it out. Where “being of service” is masking a deeper need to be seen.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Chiron, exalted in Aries, offers raw but empowering healing. It reminds you that you've lived through every version of not being chosen, and you’re still here. This moment is less about being picked and more about finally picking yourself.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: And then there’s Uranus, exalted in Taurus and making a sextile. This is kinda a wild card. A door opening you didn’t expect. A moment of freedom you didn’t know you needed. A chance to finally stop performing and just be.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: In the background, Saturn and Neptune retrograde continue to do their quiet work, helping you build a dream that’s grounded in something lasting. One foot in the vision, one foot in the reality. You won’t see it all now. But if you start building around what’s real, what lights you up, not what earns you applause, the path will reveal itself.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Every 19 years, the Moon returns to the same degree and sign during the same season, creating what’s known as a Metonic cycle, a pattern that binds time through memory. This Leo New Moon at 2° is an echo of the one that occurred in July 2006.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Back in 2006, the early foundations of digital identity were taking shape. Twitter launched that spring. Facebook was expanding beyond Harvard. Leo, the sign associated with self-expression and visibility, was activated during a time when the internet was beginning to reshape how we presented ourselves to the world. If you were coming of age then, you were learning to build an online version of yourself, one that could be seen, liked, or accepted. If you were already in the workforce, you may have noticed how LinkedIn, launched in 2003, started to influence hiring and professional image. That era marked a shift in how we began to curate our identities online, both personally and professionally.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: For artists and creatives, communities like DeviantArt, LiveJournal, and fan forums offered the first real digital canvases. Art was shared raw, imperfect, and alive. There were no algorithms to game, no pressure to brand your process. You were learning how to show your work sometimes before you understood yourself. And for many, that was the first time they felt seen.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: But as the internet evolved, so did the rules of visibility. Sharing became performance. You became content. The freedom of early digital expression gave way to timelines, metrics, and pressure to be consistent.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Reflect on 2006. What was beginning then? What online identity were you just starting to claim? What creative expressions were you afraid to own? What mask were you building? And now, what if you let yourself be as awkward, unfiltered, and real as you were the first time you tried to figure out who you were online?
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: And if you were too young to remember, or weren’t born yet, you’ve still inherited the impact of that time. You’ve grown up in a world shaped by its standards: its aesthetic, its pace, and its focus on visibility. It was the beginning of a culture that encouraged people to show up online.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: Now, with this Leo New Moon in 2025, you have a chance to reflect and redefine what visibility means to you. This isn’t about impressing others or perfecting your image. It’s about reconnecting with your creativity and showing up as yourself. Not for content, but for presence and connection.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The New Moon hits your fifth house, lighting up your creativity, your joy, and how you express who the hell you are. This is your chance to get back to what makes you feel alive. If you’ve been through a breakup, lost your job, hit a wall with your art, or just felt straight-up burnt out, this is the turning point. This is the moment to stop playing small and choose yourself. Not for likes. Not for approval. For you.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: With Chiron exalted in your sign, isn't soft. It’s not a candle and a journal. It's healing is about choosing yourself, especially when it’s hard. Pluto’s opposition to this Moon highlights the pressure you've felt to tone yourself down or make yourself more "acceptable." It’s time to release those old rules. Mercury rx is moving through this same area, asking you to revise how you relate to creativity, play, and self-worth. Maybe you’ve been performing the role of “artist” or “innovator” based on what others expect, rather than what feels real to you. Maybe you've stopped creating altogether because of fear, rejection, or burnout. This retrograde offers a chance to explore what your creative voice sounds like, when you’re not editing it for someone else's comfort. What would you express if you weren’t worried about money or being flagged? The Venus-Mars square may bring up old habits, like overextending yourself to gain approval or trying to turn your creativity into something productive before it’s even had a chance to breathe. If you've been burning yourself out trying to earn validation, this is a moment to stop and reassess.
entries.author: Marie Satori
entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: The pressure to be what others expect is real, but so is your capacity to choose yourself. If you’re rebuilding after a breakup, a layoff, or losing your creative spark, this Moon asks you to name what you want without asking for permission. You’re not here to impress anyone. You’re here to live a life that feels like yours.

entries.text: Your fourth house of home, family, and emotional foundations is going through major changes. This New Moon opposite Pluto is asking what kind of home you built to survive, and what kind of home you actually need now. If you’re healing from the loss of a home, a relationship, or your sense of belonging, this lunation invites you to begin. Old memories may resurface, especially from childhood or past homes, prompting you to reexamine what “belonging” has meant to you. Uranus in your sign is the wild card. It brings a sudden opportunity to put down roots. Mercury retrograde is helping you rewrite the story of where you belong. That childhood wound around belonging is ready for fierce healing. The Venus Mars square shows tension between what you truly value and what you've been told to value. Trust your body's wisdom more than the world's expectations.

entries.text: If you've recently lost a relationship, a job, or a sense of home, this Moon may bring up grief, but it also brings clarity. You’re being asked to let go of the version of “home” that may not exist anymore.

entries.text: The New Moon illuminates your third house of communication and daily reality. If you’ve recently felt silenced or overlooked, either in work or in love, it’s time to speak from the version of you that no longer needs approval. Pluto in your ninth house challenges your beliefs. Mercury retrograde in your third house is offering you the opportunity to revisit how you communicate. With Venus in your sign squaring Mars, there may be tension. Stop trying to be so likable. Start being honest. The wound around not being heard, keeps existing because you're afraid to touch it. Your voice matters. Speak from the center of your truth.
entries.author: Marie Satori

entries.text: Your second house of values, self-worth, and resources is getting a major overhaul under this New Moon. Opposite Pluto, this lunation is revealing just how much of your self-esteem has been shaped by what others have expected, or demanded, from you. Saturn and Neptune retrograde in your fellow water signs are laying down new foundations where your dream and your discipline can finally work together. Mercury retrograde is also moving through this same area, inviting you to reassess how you think and talk about your own value. Old stories may surface, things you were told growing up, past experiences that shaped how you handle money or how you respond to praise and criticism. The Venus Mars square highlights the tension between your instinct to nurture and your desire to be recognized for more than your caretaking. You don’t have to earn love through service. Your existence is enough. You’re allowed to say “enough.” You’re allowed to say “mine.” You’re allowed to want more.

entries.text: Happy Birthday Leo! This is your moment but not in the way you might expect. The New Moon in your sign opposite Pluto is stripping away every mask you've ever worn to make yourself more acceptable. Mercury retrograde, moving through your sign and conjunct the New Moon, deepens this inward journey. It’s helping you rewrite your identity story, the one you tell yourself every day. You might find yourself revisiting past decisions, old journals, photos, or versions of yourself you thought you'd outgrown. That Pluto opposition is showing you which parts of yourself you abandoned to fit into systems that could never contain your light. Let go of the need to brand your personality. You are not a product. The Venus-Mars square intensifies the tension in your relationships, especially where you’ve felt pressure to be perfect, productive, or constantly "on" in order to be loved. Chiron in Aries reminds you that you've survived every version of not being chosen. Now choose yourself.

entries.text: The New Moon in your twelfth house is illuminating everything you've kept hidden, even from yourself. Mars and the South Node in your sign are bringing old patterns of service and self-erasure into the light. You've been trying to earn love through perfection but the Venus square is calling that out. The Pluto opposition reveals unconscious ways you’ve made yourself smaller in order to be needed. Mercury retrograde is helping you rewrite your worth story. You are not here to fix everything. Saturn and Neptune are laying new groundwork for your dreams. Ask yourself what could grow if you stopped managing other people’s chaos.

entries.provenance: Published article body preserved by packages/astro-knowledge/voice/tldr-astro/fixtures/sky-article-longform/owner-corpus/manifest.json; voice evidence only, never runtime facts.

entries.text: If you’ve lost someone, lost direction, or lost a part of yourself in caregiving or burnout, let this be a turning point. You don’t have to fix everything. Release one task that doesn’t serve your healing and don’t look back.
entries.author: Marie Satori
